title: Measuring Non-Workers' Labor Market Attachment with Machine Learning
affiliations: Banco de España and Banco de España

detail.title: Measuring Non-Workers' Labor Market Attachment with Machine Learning

publicationDetails.detailsText: Banco de Espana Working Paper No. 2534
publicationDetails.journalName: Banco de Espana Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Studying the labor market attachment (LMA) for the non-working population is crucial for several economic outcomes, such as real wages or long-term non-employment. Official statistics rely on self-reported variables and rule-based procedures to assign the labor market status of an individual. However, this classification does not take into account other individual-level characteristics, like variables related to reservation wages or the amount and type of job offers received, implying that estimates of non-worker status could be biased. In this paper, we propose a novel methodology to measure non-workers’ LMA. Using the Spanish Labor Force Survey (LFS), we define two groups (attached vs. non-attached), and estimate a probability distribution for each individual of belonging to such groups. To recover these probability distributions, we rely on unsupervised and supervised machine learning algorithms. We describe the differences between LFS unemployment, other measures of attachment in the literature, and our non-worker classification. We identify the instances in which our proposed methodology has a tighter relationship with measures like salaries, GDP and employment flows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的方法来衡量非工作人群的劳动力市场依附度（LMA），使用无监督和监督机器学习算法，基于西班牙劳动力调查数据，为每个个体分配属于"依附"或"非依附"组的概率分布。
AI.research_question: 如何更准确地衡量非工作人群的劳动力市场依附度（LMA），以解决传统官方统计中基于自我报告和规则程序可能存在的偏差问题？
AI.motivation: 官方统计依赖自我报告变量和基于规则的程序来分配个人劳动力市场状态，但这种分类没有考虑其他个体特征（如保留工资、收到的职位数量和类型等），导致非工作者状态的估计可能存在偏差。准确衡量非工作人群的LMA对实际工资、长期非就业等经济结果至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场依附度理论、非工作人群分类理论、机器学习在经济学中的应用理论
AI.method: 使用西班牙劳动力调查（LFS）数据，定义"依附"和"非依附"两个群体，采用无监督和监督机器学习算法为每个个体恢复属于这些群体的概率分布。
AI.findings: 描述了LFS失业率、文献中其他依附度测量方法以及本文提出的非工作者分类之间的差异；识别了本文提出的方法与工资、GDP和就业流动等指标关系更紧密的情况。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于机器学习的非工作者劳动力市场依附度测量新方法；建立了更准确的劳动力市场状态分类框架；为劳动力市场分析提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更准确的劳动力市场依附度测量工具；有助于更好地理解非工作人群的经济行为；可用于改进劳动力市场政策的制定和评估。

title: ESG Drivers of Financial Development: A Multimethod Analysis of Domestic Credit to the Private Sector
affiliations: University of Catania, Lum University Giuseppe Degennaro, Università Niccolò Cusano and Lum University Giuseppe Degennaro - Lum Enterprise s.r.l.

detail.title: ESG Drivers of Financial Development: A Multimethod Analysis of Domestic Credit to the Private Sector
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the influence of environmental, social, and governance (ESG) factors on financial development, using Domestic Credit to the Private Sector by Banks (DCB) as the core indicator of credit market development. To effectively market the research within the broader literature on finance and ESG issues, the authors employ an approach combining econometric analysis, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), cluster analysis, and network analysis. By analyzing the impact through the estimation of the model parameters through the impact of instrumental variable estimation on the model parameters (using Two-Stage Least Squares (IV), Random Effects (IV), and First-Differenced (IV) methods), the study confirms that access to clean fuels and natural resource depletion impact the model margins significantly. However, across all the models used in the analysis, the impact of access to clean energy is positive. By analyzing the significance of the issue using the KNN model throughout the research process on the impact of ESG on credit market dynamics across countries, the research demonstrates that the issue is significant. By performing hierarchical cluster analysis on the significance of the research by considering the significance of the issue in its contribution to the impact on credit market dynamics in countries, in terms of climate stress issues being core in influencing the dynamics of credit in countries, through network analysis mapping performed by carrying out research on the topic.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨ESG因素对金融发展的影响，以银行对私营部门的国内信贷作为信贷市场发展的核心指标。研究发现清洁能源获取对信贷市场有积极影响，而自然资源耗竭则产生显著负面影响。
AI.research_question: 环境、社会和治理（ESG）因素如何影响信贷市场发展？
AI.motivation: 随着ESG议题在全球金融领域的重要性日益增加，需要实证研究ESG因素对信贷市场发展的具体影响，为政策制定和金融实践提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融发展理论、ESG投资理论和可持续发展理论，探讨ESG因素通过信贷渠道影响金融发展的机制。
AI.method: 采用计量经济学分析（包括工具变量法、两阶段最小二乘法、随机效应模型、一阶差分法）、K最近邻算法、聚类分析和网络分析相结合的方法。
AI.findings: 1. 清洁能源获取对信贷市场发展有显著正向影响；2. 自然资源耗竭对信贷市场产生显著负面影响；3. 气候压力问题是影响各国信贷动态的核心因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了ESG因素与信贷市场发展的理论联系；2. 提出了ESG通过信贷渠道影响金融发展的机制框架；3. 丰富了金融发展与可持续发展交叉领域的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为金融机构在信贷决策中考虑ESG因素提供实证依据；2. 为政策制定者设计促进可持续金融发展的政策提供参考；3. 帮助投资者理解ESG因素对信贷市场风险的影响。

title: Quantifying Generic/Biosimilar Companies’ Loss: Neither Easy Nor Adequate
affiliations: University of Oxford - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Quantifying Generic/Biosimilar Companies’ Loss: Neither Easy Nor Adequate

declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported, in part, by a Novo Nordisk Foundation Grant for a scientifically independent International Collaborative Bioscience Innovation & Law Programme (Inter-CeBIL programme-grant no.NNF23SA0087056) and the St. Hilda’s Social Sciences Graduate Studentship.

detail.abstract:
The courts usually grant interim injunctions in originator versus generic cases because judges have readily accepted that generic market entry will cause irreparable patentees This article challenges this assumption.

It argues that originator companies’ loss is reparable and can be quantified in damages because it is possible to document their loss using historic sales data. That is, however, not the case for generic companies. Unlike originator companies, who have already sold the medicine for years, there are no previous sales figures that judges may use to calculate a generic company’s loss.

This means that it is neither easy nor adequate to calculate their loss, rendering damages an inadequate remedy for generic companies. More interim injunctions should therefore be refused on this basis.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了专利侵权案件中临时禁令的常规做法，认为仿制药公司的损失比原研药公司更难量化，因此应更少批准临时禁令。
AI.research_question: 在专利侵权案件中，临时禁令是否应该更少地批准？特别是针对原研药公司与仿制药公司之间的纠纷？
AI.motivation: 法院通常在原研药与仿制药专利纠纷中批准临时禁令，因为法官普遍接受仿制药进入市场会对专利持有人造成不可弥补的损失。本文挑战这一假设。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于专利法中的临时禁令理论，特别是"不可弥补损失"原则，以及损害赔偿的可量化性理论。
AI.method: 理论分析，基于法律原则和商业现实的逻辑推理，比较原研药公司和仿制药公司在损失量化方面的差异。
AI.findings: 原研药公司的损失可以通过历史销售数据量化，因此是可弥补的；而仿制药公司没有历史销售数据，损失难以充分计算，损害赔偿对仿制药公司来说是不充分的救济方式。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了专利侵权案件中临时禁令的常规假设，提出了损失可量化性的新视角，强调不同类型公司在损失计算上的不对称性。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议法院应基于仿制药公司损失难以量化的理由，更多地拒绝临时禁令申请，这将对专利诉讼策略和仿制药市场准入产生重要影响。

AI.tldr: 本文分析葡萄牙庇护和辅助保护法律框架，重点关注边境口岸不可受理决定司法上诉的特殊时限规定
AI.research_question: 葡萄牙边境口岸庇护申请不可受理决定的司法上诉特殊时限规定如何运作？其法律框架存在哪些问题？
AI.motivation: 边境口岸庇护申请的快速处理程序对申请人权利保护构成挑战，需要分析特殊时限规定对司法救济的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际难民法、欧盟庇护法、行政程序法、司法救济权理论
AI.method: 法律文本分析、案例研究、比较法分析、规范性分析
AI.findings: 葡萄牙边境口岸不可受理决定的司法上诉时限过短，可能违反有效司法救济原则；现行规定与欧盟标准存在差距
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了边境口岸庇护程序司法救济的理论框架，提出了时限规定与权利保护的平衡模型
AI.practical_contributions: 为葡萄牙立法改革提供建议，为其他欧盟国家边境庇护程序提供参考，增强难民权利保护

title: ANALYZING THE IMPACT OF VIRTUAL ASSISTANT WORK ON LABOR PRODUCTIVITY AND ECONOMIC GROWTH IN NUEVA ECIJA: BASIS FOR STRENGTHENING POLICIES AND ORGANIZATIONAL PRACTICES
affiliations: Nueva Ecija University of Science and Technology, Nueva Ecija University of Science and Technology, Nueva Ecija University of Science and Technology and Nueva Ecija University of Science and Technology

detail.title: ANALYZING THE IMPACT OF VIRTUAL ASSISTANT WORK ON LABOR PRODUCTIVITY AND ECONOMIC GROWTH IN NUEVA ECIJA: BASIS FOR STRENGTHENING POLICIES AND ORGANIZATIONAL PRACTICES
detail.abstract: This study examined the labor productivity, economic implications, and work challenges experienced by virtual assistants (VAs) in Nueva Ecija. The growing demand for remote work highlights the need to understand how VA employment supports individual performance and contributes to local economic activity. The research aimed to describe the respondents' profile, assess the effects of VA work on productivity, determine its economic impact, and identify key challenges affecting their work. A descriptive quantitative design was used, with data collected from 385 VAs through an online survey. Findings show that the VA workforce is mostly female, highly educated, and engaged in full-time work. Results indicate that VA work enhances efficiency, time management, job performance, work-life balance, and job satisfaction. Economic findings reveal that VAs benefit from competitive income, reduced daily expenses, and greater financial stability while contributing to local spending and regional growth. However, technological issues, communication barriers, environmental distractions, and mental health concerns remain significant challenges. The study concludes that VA work is a productive and economically valuable profession, and improving digital infrastructure, skills training, and mental health support can strengthen the industry.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了Nueva Ecija地区虚拟助理的劳动生产力、经济影响和工作挑战。研究发现VA工作能提高效率、时间管理、工作绩效和工作满意度，带来经济收益，但面临技术问题、沟通障碍等挑战。
AI.research_question: 虚拟助理工作的劳动生产力、经济影响以及面临的主要挑战是什么？
AI.motivation: 远程工作需求增长，需要了解VA就业如何支持个人绩效并促进地方经济活动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于远程工作理论、劳动生产力理论和区域经济发展理论，分析虚拟助理工作的多重影响。
AI.method: 采用描述性定量研究设计，通过在线问卷调查收集385名虚拟助理的数据。
AI.findings: 1. VA劳动力主要为女性、高学历、全职工作；2. VA工作提高效率、时间管理、工作绩效、工作生活平衡和工作满意度；3. 经济上带来竞争性收入、减少日常开支、增强财务稳定性，促进地方消费和区域增长；4. 主要挑战包括技术问题、沟通障碍、环境干扰和心理健康问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了远程工作理论在发展中国家区域环境中的应用；2. 提供了虚拟助理工作对个人生产力多维影响的实证证据；3. 丰富了数字经济对地方经济影响的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供改善数字基础设施、技能培训和心理健康支持的依据；2. 为VA从业者提供职业发展参考；3. 为企业优化远程工作管理提供实践指导；4. 促进区域数字经济发展战略的制定。

title: Investing in Land Tamilnadu A Community-Friendly

detail.title: Investing in Land Tamilnadu A Community-Friendly
detail.abstract: This paper provides an easy-to-understand guide for people who want to invest in land in Tamil Nadu. It covers the complete process — from checking the land’s legal documents and Vāstu compliance to final registration, name transfer, and post-purchase care. Case studies included Coimbatore and Chennai.

AI.tldr: 本文为想要在泰米尔纳德邦投资土地的人士提供了一份易于理解的指南，涵盖了从检查土地法律文件、Vāstu合规性到最终注册、名称转移和购买后维护的完整流程，并以哥印拜陀和金奈为案例研究。
AI.research_question: 如何为泰米尔纳德邦的土地投资提供一个全面且易于理解的指南？
AI.motivation: 泰米尔纳德邦的土地投资过程复杂，涉及法律文件检查、Vāstu合规性、注册和名称转移等多个环节，投资者需要清晰的指导以避免风险和错误。
AI.theoretical_framework: 土地投资流程管理、房地产法律合规、Vāstu（印度传统建筑学）原则、产权转移理论。
AI.method: 基于实践经验的指南开发方法，结合哥印拜陀和金奈的案例研究，分析土地投资的实际流程和挑战。
AI.findings: 提供了从初始文件检查到最终注册的完整土地投资流程指南，识别了关键风险点，强调了Vāstu合规的重要性，并通过案例研究展示了实际应用。
AI.theory_contributions: 将土地投资流程系统化，整合了法律合规和Vāstu传统原则，为印度特定地区的房地产投资提供了结构化框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了实用的逐步指南，帮助避免常见错误，确保法律合规，优化投资决策，特别适用于泰米尔纳德邦的土地投资场景。

reference: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No.25-064
title: Turbulence Ahead: Economic Policies for Decarbonizing Aviation
affiliations: ZEW – Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research and ZEW – Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research

detail.title: Turbulence Ahead: Economic Policies for Decarbonizing Aviation

publicationDetails.detailsText: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No.25-064
publicationDetails.journalName: ZEW - Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study the design of climate policy for hard-to-abate sectors, focusing on global aviation. We build a spatial equilibrium model that links ticket booking data, the global airline network, and climate regulated airlines’ choices in imperfectly competitive air transport markets. We find that sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) quotas outperform carbon pricing, delivering equal emissions cuts at 46–66% of the welfare cost. Ignoring market structure understates the cost of price-based Pigouvian instruments when fuel-capital substitution is limited. SAF quotas are more robust to regulatory scope, cause less carbon leakage, and—when layered with existing carbon pricing— increase abatement while lowering welfare cost. Relying on carbon offsets risks locking in fossil jet fuel, whereas cost-effective in-sector abatement hinges on substantial SAF uptake.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过空间均衡模型分析全球航空业气候政策，发现可持续航空燃料配额比碳定价更有效，能以46-66%的福利成本实现同等减排效果。配额政策对监管范围更稳健，碳泄漏更少，与现有碳定价结合可提高减排同时降低福利成本。
AI.research_question: 针对难以减排的全球航空业，哪种气候政策设计（碳定价vs可持续航空燃料配额）在福利成本和减排效果上更优？
AI.motivation: 全球航空业是难以减排的关键部门，需要有效的政策工具来推动脱碳。现有研究对市场结构在气候政策设计中的作用关注不足，特别是在燃料-资本替代有限的情况下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间均衡理论、不完全竞争市场理论、庇古税理论、环境经济学中的政策工具比较框架
AI.method: 构建空间均衡模型，整合机票预订数据、全球航空网络数据，模拟不完全竞争市场中航空公司的决策行为
AI.findings: 1. SAF配额优于碳定价，能以46-66%的福利成本实现同等减排；2. 忽略市场结构会低估价格型庇古工具的成本；3. SAF配额对监管范围更稳健，碳泄漏更少；4. 配额与碳定价结合可提高减排同时降低福利成本；5. 碳补偿可能锁定化石燃料使用，而有效的行业减排依赖于SAF的大规模采用
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将市场结构纳入气候政策分析框架；2. 揭示了燃料-资本替代有限条件下价格型工具的局限性；3. 为配额与碳定价的协同效应提供理论解释
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供航空业气候政策设计的具体建议；2. 证明SAF配额是更有效的政策工具；3. 警示碳补偿的风险；4. 提出政策组合方案以平衡减排与福利成本

title: Can AI Fully Automate Human Work? Biological Limits from Endogenous Mortality
affiliations: Soka University

detail.title: Can AI Fully Automate Human Work? Biological Limits from Endogenous Mortality
detail.abstract: In economies with aging populations and shrinking workforces, automation is promoted as a response to labor scarcity. This paper introduces a health perspective to the automation debate and extends a task-based automation framework to include health investment, endogenous mortality, and health-dependent feasibility of labor. Mortality raises the user cost of capital and suppresses automation. Health investment lowers mortality, reduces capital costs and facilitates automation. However, increased longevity simultaneously tightens the transversality condition, suggesting an additional biological limit on the extent of automation. The model is calibrated using Japanese mortality data to illustrate this mechanism.

AI.tldr: 该研究将健康视角引入自动化辩论，在任务型自动化框架中加入健康投资、内生死亡率和健康依赖的劳动可行性。研究发现死亡率提高资本使用成本并抑制自动化，而健康投资降低死亡率、减少资本成本并促进自动化，但寿命延长同时收紧横截条件，表明存在额外的生物限制约束自动化程度。
AI.research_question: 在人口老龄化和劳动力萎缩的经济体中，健康投资如何影响自动化决策？健康与自动化之间存在怎样的相互作用机制？
AI.motivation: 现有自动化研究主要关注技术替代劳动力，但忽略了健康因素对自动化决策的影响。在老龄化社会中，健康投资可能通过影响死亡率和资本成本来改变自动化进程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展的任务型自动化框架，纳入健康投资、内生死亡率、健康依赖的劳动可行性。结合资本使用成本理论和横截条件分析。
AI.method: 理论模型构建与校准分析。使用日本死亡率数据进行模型校准，以说明健康-自动化相互作用机制。
AI.findings: 1) 死亡率提高资本使用成本，抑制自动化投资；2) 健康投资降低死亡率，减少资本成本，促进自动化；3) 寿命延长收紧横截条件，对自动化程度形成生物限制；4) 健康与自动化存在复杂的相互作用关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将健康视角系统性地引入自动化理论框架，揭示了健康投资通过死亡率渠道影响资本成本和自动化决策的新机制，提出了"生物限制"对自动化的约束概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为老龄化社会的政策制定提供新视角：健康投资不仅改善人口健康，还能通过促进自动化缓解劳动力短缺。同时提醒政策制定者注意自动化程度的生物限制。

title: Social Media and Behavioral Economics: Do Likes Affect Purchases?
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Social Media and Behavioral Economics: Do Likes Affect Purchases?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I, Sargun Malhi, the sole author of this research paper titled “Social Media and Behavioral Economics: Do Likes Affect Purchases?”, declare that: I have no personal, financial, or professional conflict of interest that could have influenced the research presented in this study. This research was conducted independently, without any sponsorship, funding, or external influence from any organization or individual. All data was collected solely for academic and research purposes, and the results are reported honestly and accurately. Therefore, I confirm that there is no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical Approval Statement This research titled “Social Media and Behavioral Economics: Do Likes Affect Purchases?” was conducted with strict consideration of ethical guidelines. The following points were ensured during data collection: Voluntary Participation: Participation in the survey was completely voluntary. No participant was forced or pressured to give responses. Informed Consent: Participants were informed about the purpose of the research, and their consent was taken before collecting responses. Anonymity & Privacy: No personal information such as names, contact numbers, or identity markers were collected. All responses were kept anonymous. No Harm to Participants: The survey contained no sensitive, harmful, or emotionally distressing questions. Data Usage: All collected data was used strictly for academic and research purposes only. Age Group Consideration: The study included participants aged 15–25. For participants below 18, informal verbal consent was obtained through school peers/parents wherever required. Institutional Compliance: The research was conducted as an independent student project under the academic guidelines of Governor Senior Secondary School, Ramdas. Therefore, this research complies with basic ethical standards for academic studies involving human participants

detail.abstract: This study analyzes whether social media likes influence purchasing decisions from a behavioral economics perspective. Using a survey-based experiment on 100 participants aged 15-25, the inquiry analyzed how likes influence trust, recognized value, emotional acquisition triggers, and consumer decision-making. Results suggest that high engagement (likes) considerably increases purchase aim, even when product quality remains constant. The study highlights fundamental mental biases; social proof, FOMO, herd mentality, and anchoring; which shape online consumer behavior. Recommendations are supplied for moral marketing methods and digital literacy improvement among youth. 1. To examine whether a greater number of likes increases purchase purpose. 2. To study which behavioral biases are activated by likes. 3. To analyze if teenagers and young adults depend on social proof over product quality. 4. To suggest moral marketing approaches established on behavioral economics.

AI.tldr: 本研究从行为经济学角度分析社交媒体点赞是否影响购买决策。通过100名15-25岁参与者的调查实验，发现高点赞量显著增加购买意向，即使产品质量不变。研究揭示了社交证明、错失恐惧、从众心理和锚定效应等认知偏差如何塑造在线消费行为，并为道德营销和青少年数字素养提升提供建议。
AI.research_question:
1. 更多点赞是否会增加购买意向？
2. 点赞激活了哪些行为偏差？
3. 青少年是否更依赖社交证明而非产品质量？
4. 基于行为经济学的道德营销方法是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着社交媒体在青少年消费决策中的影响力日益增强，需要从行为经济学角度理解点赞等社交信号如何影响购买行为，揭示潜在认知偏差，为道德营销和数字素养教育提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学理论框架，包括社交证明、错失恐惧(FOMO)、从众心理、锚定效应等认知偏差理论。
AI.method: 基于调查的实验方法，对100名15-25岁参与者进行研究，分析点赞对信任、感知价值、情感触发和消费决策的影响。
AI.findings: 高点赞量显著增加购买意向，即使产品质量保持不变。点赞激活了社交证明、错失恐惧、从众心理和锚定效应等认知偏差，青少年更依赖社交信号而非产品质量信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 将行为经济学认知偏差理论应用于社交媒体环境，实证验证了点赞作为社交信号如何影响青少年消费决策的心理机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为营销人员提供道德营销策略建议，强调需要平衡商业目标与消费者保护；为教育工作者提供数字素养教育方向，帮助青少年识别和抵抗社交媒体中的认知偏差影响。

title: Mean-Reversions in the Debt-to-GDP Ratio and Predictability of Treasury Debt Returns and Surpluses
affiliations: Changsha University of Science and Technology, College of Finance and Statistics, Hunan University and WISE and School of Economics, Xiamen University

detail.title: Mean-Reversions in the Debt-to-GDP Ratio and Predictability of Treasury Debt Returns and Surpluses
detail.abstract: The debt-to-GDP (DG) ratio should predict Treasury returns and primary surpluses according to the present-value identity, yet empirical support remains elusive. This paper resolves this puzzle by decomposing the DG ratio into a slow mean-reversion component and a local mean-reversion component. We show that the local mean-reversion of the DG ratio delivers substantially improved out-of-sample forecast gains of Treasury debt returns and surpluses, outperforming the original DG ratio, the historical average benchmark, and the adjusted ratios subject to structural breaks. In contrast, the slow mean-reversion component obscures predictive information by incorporating persistent, non-fundamental variation. Our findings are robust to alternative decomposition methods and DG ratio definitions (including nonmarketable debt). We develop a revised fiscal present-value model to rationalize the findings.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过将债务-GDP比率分解为缓慢均值回归和局部均值回归两个成分，解决了债务-GDP比率预测国债回报和财政盈余的实证难题。研究发现局部均值回归成分显著提高了预测能力，而缓慢均值回归成分则因包含持久性非基本面变异而掩盖了预测信息。
AI.research_question: 如何解决债务-GDP比率预测国债回报和财政盈余的实证难题？债务-GDP比率的何种成分真正包含预测信息？
AI.motivation: 根据现值恒等式，债务-GDP比率应该能够预测国债回报和财政盈余，但实证证据一直难以找到支持。这一理论与实证之间的脱节构成了研究动机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政现值模型（fiscal present-value model），该模型基于政府预算约束和现值恒等式，将债务-GDP比率与未来国债回报和财政盈余联系起来。
AI.method: 将债务-GDP比率分解为缓慢均值回归成分和局部均值回归成分，使用样本外预测方法评估各成分的预测能力，并与原始比率、历史平均基准以及考虑结构断点的调整比率进行比较。
AI.findings: 局部均值回归成分显著提高了国债债务回报和财政盈余的样本外预测能力，优于原始债务-GDP比率、历史平均基准和考虑结构断点的调整比率。缓慢均值回归成分因包含持久性非基本面变异而掩盖了预测信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了修订的财政现值模型来解释研究发现，为债务-GDP比率的预测能力提供了理论解释，解决了理论与实证之间的脱节问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和政策制定者提供了改进的债务-GDP比率分解方法，能够更准确地预测国债回报和财政盈余，有助于投资决策和财政政策评估。

title: Determinants of Formal Social Care Receipt in Settings of Public Funding Shortages
affiliations: The University of Manchester, The University of Manchester and The University of Manchester

detail.title: Determinants of Formal Social Care Receipt in Settings of Public Funding Shortages
detail.abstract: Ageing populations are creating increasing demand for formal social care in many countries and shortages in public funding for long-term care are likely to change who receives it. This study provides contemporary empirical evidence from England, during a period of sustained austerity policies and evolving family structures, and addresses a gap in the literature that has relied largely on pre-austerity data. Using data from 7,095 community-dwelling older adults in the 2018-19 English Longitudinal Study of Ageing (ELSA), we examine the demographic, health and economic determinants of receiving formal care and state-funded support in a means-tested system. We estimate weighted stepwise multivariate logit models to identify key predictors of care receipt, using variance inflation factors to account for multicollinearity. Receiving formal support is most strongly predicted by functional limitations in Instrumental Activities of Daily Living (IADLs) and mobility, and to a lesser extent by Activities of Daily Living (ADLs), while individuals in lower income quintiles are significantly less likely to receive formal care. Conversely, those in lower wealth quintiles demonstrate higher odds of receiving state-funded care. Marital status and co-residence patterns also influence utilisation with single, widowed, or divorced individuals more likely to rely on formal services, implying a substitution effect with informal care. These findings quantify how access to publicly funded social care is strongly conditioned by the severity of an individual’s health and economic needs, thus raising important policy questions on stringent means-testing, frozen capital thresholds and widening inequalities in care access.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用2018-19年英国老龄化纵向研究数据，分析了在紧缩政策背景下，社区居住老年人获得正式护理和国家资助护理的决定因素，发现功能限制和经济状况是主要预测因素。
AI.research_question: 在英国紧缩政策和家庭结构变化的背景下，社区居住老年人获得正式护理和国家资助护理的人口、健康和经济决定因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 人口老龄化增加了对正式社会护理的需求，而长期护理公共资金短缺可能改变护理接受者群体。现有文献主要依赖紧缩政策前的数据，需要提供当代实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会护理获取的决定因素理论，包括功能限制理论、经济资源理论、家庭支持替代理论，以及紧缩政策对护理分配的影响。
AI.method: 使用2018-19年英国老龄化纵向研究(ELSA)中7,095名社区居住老年人的数据，采用加权逐步多元逻辑回归模型，使用方差膨胀因子处理多重共线性。
AI.findings: 正式护理接受的最强预测因素是工具性日常生活活动(IADLs)和移动能力的功能限制，其次是基本日常生活活动(ADLs)。低收入群体获得正式护理的可能性显著较低，而低财富群体获得国家资助护理的几率更高。单身、丧偶或离婚个体更依赖正式服务，表明与非正式护理存在替代效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了紧缩政策时期社会护理获取决定因素的当代实证证据，验证了功能限制和经济资源理论在护理分配中的作用，揭示了正式与非正式护理的替代关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果量化了公共资助社会护理获取如何受个人健康和经济需求的严重程度影响，为政策制定者提供了关于严格经济状况调查、冻结资本门槛和护理获取不平等扩大的重要政策问题依据。

title: Why Governments Make Suboptimal Decisions During Crises
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Why Governments Make Suboptimal Decisions During Crises
detail.abstract: This paper argues that crises do not destroy governmental rationality; they reveal what has always existed beneath the surface. I introduce a behavioral–institutional framework showing that governments systematically fall into what can be called the “Survival–Rationality Gap”: a state in which policymakers know the correct economic action but are incentivized to choose the politically safer but economically inferior option. Using behavioral bias, institutional constraints, and expectation shocks—supported by a micro‑level managerial case—the paper suggests that suboptimal policymaking is often not a “bad choice” but a “survival‑optimized choice.” The paper concludes by asking whether crisis‑resilient policymaking requires institutional redesign or a redefinition of political survival itself.

AI.tldr: 危机并不摧毁政府理性，而是揭示了表面之下的常态。论文提出了一个行为-制度框架，显示政府会陷入"生存-理性鸿沟"：决策者知道正确的经济行动，但被激励选择政治上更安全但经济上更差的选择。次优政策制定往往不是"错误选择"而是"生存优化选择"。
AI.research_question: 危机是否摧毁政府理性？为什么政府会做出经济上非最优但政治上安全的政策选择？危机韧性政策制定需要制度重新设计还是政治生存定义的重新界定？
AI.motivation: 理解危机时期政府决策的悖论：为什么明知正确的经济行动，政府却选择次优政策？揭示危机如何暴露而非创造政府决策的根本问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为-制度框架，包含行为偏见、制度约束和预期冲击三个核心要素，解释"生存-理性鸿沟"现象。
AI.method: 理论框架构建，辅以微观层面的管理案例支持分析。
AI.findings: 危机不破坏政府理性，而是揭示其内在矛盾。政府决策者陷入"生存-理性鸿沟"，知道正确经济行动但选择政治上更安全的次优选项。次优政策制定往往是"生存优化选择"而非"错误选择"。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"生存-理性鸿沟"概念和解释框架，挑战了传统危机决策理论，将行为偏见、制度约束和预期冲击整合分析政府决策。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供理解决策困境的框架，指出危机韧性政策制定可能需要重新设计制度或重新定义政治生存本身。

title: Emerging Workplace Childcare Service in Ethiopia: Exploring Experience, Determinants of Use, Benefits and Challenges of Use Among Mothers Working at the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia Ministry of Revenue
affiliations: Policy Studies Institute

detail.title: Emerging Workplace Childcare Service in Ethiopia: Exploring Experience, Determinants of Use, Benefits and Challenges of Use Among Mothers Working at the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia Ministry of Revenue

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. This research was conducted independently, and there were no financial or non-financial conflicts of interest related to the study. The findings of this study are not influenced by any external parties, organizations, or funding sources. declarations.ethicsApproval: This study was conducted in accordance with internationally accepted ethical standards, including the principles outlined in the Declaration of Helsinki. Before data collection, informed consent was obtained from all participants. They were fully informed about the purpose of the research, the voluntary nature of their participation, and their right to withdraw at any time without any penalty. All responses were anonymized to ensure confidentiality and privacy. The study adhered to the principles of beneficence, non-maleficence, autonomy, and justice. detail.abstract: The increasing participation of women in formal employment across various sectors has become evident in many developing countries, including Ethiopia, over the past few decades. This shift has created gaps in unpaid care work, which was traditionally performed by women. The establishment of workplace childcare services has emerged as one policy response to address the challenges associated with this transition. In Ethiopia, workplace childcare is a relatively recent development, with the proclamation mandating its establishment introduced only in 2018. This study examines the experiences, benefits, and challenges related to the use of workplace childcare services among public-sector mothers employed at the Ministry of Revenue in Ethiopia. As more women join the formal workforce, the need for institutional support mechanisms, such as workplace daycare, has become increasingly important. However, despite the policy requirement, limited research has explored how the 2018 directive has been implemented or how it affects working mothers and their children in practice. To fill this gap, the study adopted a mixed-methods approach, combining quantitative data from a structured survey of 89 mothers with qualitative evidence from 10 in-depth interviews and three key informant interviews. Descriptive statistics, correlation analysis, and thematic coding were used to assess the influence of workplace childcare on maternal well-being, child development, and job performance. The findings indicate that mothers primarily use workplace childcare due to time constraints, limited alternative childcare options, and financial considerations. The service was found to offer multiple benefits, including improved child health, enhanced cognitive development, reduced maternal stress, and better workplace productivity. However, several challenges were identified, such as strict age limitations for enrollment, exposure to illness, and the stress of preparing children early in the morning. The study confirmed significant correlations between perceived childcare quality, reduced maternal stress, and higher job satisfaction. Overall, the results highlight the critical role of institutional childcare in promoting gender equity, enhancing employee performance, and supporting child development within Ethiopia's public sector. The study recommends policy revisions to expand eligibility criteria, strengthen operational standards, and extend workplace childcare provisions to other public and private institutions. Future research directions include longitudinal studies and broader perspectives involving non-users and male caregivers.

AI.tldr: 埃塞俄比亚公共部门职场托儿服务研究：探讨职场托儿对在职母亲、儿童发展和工作绩效的影响，发现服务带来多重益处但也面临年龄限制、疾病暴露等挑战，建议政策修订以扩大覆盖范围。
AI.research_question: 埃塞俄比亚公共部门职场托儿服务的使用经验、益处和挑战是什么？职场托儿服务如何影响在职母亲的福祉、儿童发展和工作绩效？
AI.motivation: 随着埃塞俄比亚女性参与正规就业的增加，传统无偿照护工作出现缺口。2018年埃塞俄比亚颁布了职场托儿服务规定，但缺乏关于该政策实施效果及其对在职母亲和儿童实际影响的研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别平等理论、工作-家庭平衡理论、儿童发展理论、机构支持机制理论
AI.method: 混合方法：定量数据来自89位母亲的结构化问卷调查，定性数据来自10个深度访谈和3个关键知情人访谈。使用描述性统计、相关分析和主题编码分析数据。
AI.findings: 母亲使用职场托儿主要由于时间限制、替代托儿选项有限和经济考虑。服务带来多重益处：改善儿童健康、促进认知发展、减轻母亲压力、提高工作生产力。但也面临挑战：严格的年龄限制、疾病暴露风险、清晨准备孩子的压力。托儿质量感知与减轻母亲压力、提高工作满意度显著相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家职场托儿服务研究提供实证证据，深化对机构支持机制在促进性别平等和工作-家庭平衡中作用的理解，扩展了工作-家庭界面理论在埃塞俄比亚背景下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为埃塞俄比亚政策制定者提供修订职场托儿政策的依据，建议扩大资格标准、加强操作标准、将服务扩展到其他公共和私营机构。为雇主提供改善员工福利和生产力的具体建议。

detail.abstract: This study investigates the relationship between life-cycle exposure to socioeconomic shocks and subsequent food insecurity in young adult households. Using two decades of longitudinal data (2002-2023) from the Young Lives study in Ethiopia, India, and Peru, we analyse how the timing of shocks influences current household food security. Our findings consistently demonstrate a significant association between recent shock exposure and food insecurity in 2023 across all countries. Crucially, in Ethiopia, exposure to shocks dating back more than a decade, as well as shocks that occurred between 2020 and 2021, are significantly associated with current food insecurity, the first highlighting the long-term, cumulative nature of food insecurity in this country, the second pointing to the persistent detrimental effects of the COVID-19 pandemic and the armed conflict in this country. Weather-related events, illness or death of a family member, and loss of income or purchasing power all correlate with increased food insecurity, even after controlling for correlations between shocks. Overall, our findings emphasize the importance of social assistance following exposure to shocks and of a life-cycle perspective when formulating policy responses to mitigate persistent food insecurity.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用埃塞俄比亚、印度和秘鲁的纵向数据，发现近期社会经济冲击与粮食不安全显著相关，在埃塞俄比亚，十多年前的冲击和2020-2021年的冲击都对当前粮食不安全有持续影响，强调了冲击的长期累积效应和生命周期的政策视角的重要性。
AI.research_question: 生命周期中社会经济冲击的暴露时间如何影响年轻成人家庭的当前粮食安全状况？
AI.motivation: 理解社会经济冲击对粮食安全的长期影响，特别是冲击发生的时间点如何塑造后续的粮食不安全状况，对于制定有效的政策干预至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生命历程理论，强调早期生活经历对后续发展的长期影响；累积劣势理论，解释社会经济冲击如何随时间积累并加剧不平等；粮食安全的多维度框架。
AI.method: 使用埃塞俄比亚、印度和秘鲁的Young Lives研究2002-2023年的纵向数据，分析冲击暴露时间与当前粮食安全的关系，控制冲击间的相关性。
AI.findings: 1. 近期冲击暴露与2023年粮食不安全在所有国家都显著相关；2. 在埃塞俄比亚，十多年前的冲击和2020-2021年的冲击都对当前粮食不安全有显著影响；3. 天气相关事件、家庭成员疾病/死亡、收入损失都与粮食不安全增加相关；4. 埃塞俄比亚的发现突出了粮食不安全的长期累积性质。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了生命历程视角在理解粮食不安全中的重要性；2. 证明了社会经济冲击的长期累积效应；3. 强调了冲击时间点在塑造粮食安全轨迹中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 强调冲击后社会援助的重要性；2. 建议采用生命周期视角制定政策应对持续粮食不安全；3. 为针对特定冲击类型（天气、健康、经济）的政策干预提供依据；4. 特别关注埃塞俄比亚等脆弱环境中的长期支持需求。

title: Biodiversity Risk Exposure and Analysts’ Forecasts
affiliations: The University of Western Australia - UWA Business School, The University of Western Australia and The University of Western Australia - UWA Business School

detail.title: Biodiversity Risk Exposure and Analysts’ Forecasts
detail.abstract: We document that greater corporate biodiversity risk exposure is associated with significantly lower earnings forecast accuracy and higher forecast dispersion among financial analysts. These effects are more pronounced for firms with higher earnings volatility or more opaque disclosure environments. Further analyses show that analysts’ professional experience, industry specialization, and biodiversity related expertise mitigate these effects. In addition, stronger stakeholder awareness of biodiversity issues attenuates the influence of biodiversity risk on analysts’ forecast accuracy and dispersion. Our findings highlight analysts’ information processing and forecasting behavior as an important channel through which biodiversity risk affects capital markets.

AI.tldr: 企业生物多样性风险暴露越高，分析师盈利预测准确性越低、预测分歧越大，分析师专业经验和利益相关者关注能缓解这种影响
AI.research_question: 企业生物多样性风险如何影响金融分析师的盈利预测准确性和预测分歧？
AI.motivation: 生物多样性风险对企业经营和资本市场的影响日益重要，但现有研究较少关注其对金融分析师信息处理和预测行为的具体影响机制

AI.method: 实证分析，使用企业生物多样性风险暴露数据、分析师盈利预测数据，进行回归分析检验假设
AI.findings: 1. 企业生物多样性风险暴露越高，分析师盈利预测准确性显著降低，预测分歧显著增大；2. 这种影响在盈利波动性更高或信息披露环境更不透明的企业中更为明显；3. 分析师的专业经验、行业专长和生物多样性相关专业知识能缓解这种负面影响；4. 利益相关者对生物多样性问题的关注度越高，生物多样性风险对分析师预测的影响越小
