detail.abstract: Current science struggles to bridge the explanatory gap between the transmission of genetic/biological information and the inheritance of psychological trauma and behaviors within families and cultures. This paper proposes a new Co-Evolutionary Epigenetic and Cultural Model which establishes a logical and mechanistic connection between these two fields. We hypothesize that Cultural Narratives (family stories, taboos, social rituals) act as environmental factors that specifically modulate individuals' epigenetic landscape (via modifications to gene expression unrelated to the DNA sequence). This mechanism helps explain the embedding and persistence of adaptive behaviors or stress syndromes across multiple generations, without requiring genetic mutation. This model provides an essential theoretical framework for: 1. Understanding the transmission of intergenerational trauma and resilience. 2. Offering a new approach to the treatment of inherited psychological disorders. 3. Opening new research avenues in computational biology and group sociology.

title: The Mirror Trap

detail.title: The Mirror Trap
detail.abstract: When practitioners use generative AI to analyze workplace conflicts, they discover an uncomfortable truth: most leadership frameworks don't work. Not because the underlying research lacks rigor-serious organizational scholarship has always included causal mechanisms, stage models, and testable predictions-but because the versions that reach practitioners have been stripped of their operational logic. What survives the translation from research to practice are metaphors, aspirations, and labels: "build psychological safety," "lead with empathy," "create alignment." AI cannot compute with these. It can only return them as generic advice. This paper argues that AI functions as an unforgiving test of framework operationalizability. Theories that encode explicit causal chains, observable stage markers, falsification conditions, and rule-based interventions produce precise AI-assisted diagnosis. Theories that rely on dispositional labels or philosophical orientation produce platitudes. The difference is not intelligence-it is structure. Drawing on expectation states theory and status construction research, I demonstrate that status-protective behavior follows stable, predictable patterns amenable to mechanistic encoding. When these patterns are formalized as diagnostic frameworks, AI can classify conflicts, identify escalation stages, and recommend structurally appropriate interventions. When they are not, AI defaults to the weighted average of conventional wisdom. The contribution is to organizational theory and management practice: AI reveals which theories are operationalizable and which are not, while simultaneously offering practitioners a new class of diagnostic capability. This has implications for how we build, teach, and deploy frameworks for organizational diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文认为生成式AI是对领导力框架可操作性的无情测试。只有包含明确因果链、可观察阶段标记、可证伪条件和基于规则干预的理论才能产生精确的AI辅助诊断，而依赖标签或哲学导向的理论只能产生陈词滥调。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI如何揭示哪些组织理论具有可操作性，哪些只是空洞的隐喻？AI如何作为组织诊断框架可操作性的测试工具？
AI.motivation: 实践者使用生成式AI分析职场冲突时发现，大多数领导力框架无效，不是因为研究缺乏严谨性，而是因为从研究到实践的转化过程中，操作逻辑被剥离，只剩下隐喻、愿望和标签，AI无法有效处理这些内容。
AI.theoretical_framework: 期望状态理论、地位建构研究、地位保护行为模式、组织诊断框架的可操作性理论
AI.method: 理论分析、概念论证，通过期望状态理论和地位建构研究展示地位保护行为如何遵循稳定、可预测的模式，适合机制化编码，并演示如何将这些模式形式化为诊断框架
AI.findings: AI作为框架可操作性的无情测试：包含明确因果链、可观察阶段标记、可证伪条件和基于规则干预的理论能产生精确诊断；依赖标签或哲学导向的理论只能产生陈词滥调。当地位保护行为模式被形式化为诊断框架时，AI可以分类冲突、识别升级阶段并推荐结构适当的干预措施
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出AI作为组织理论可操作性的测试工具；2) 区分可操作理论与空洞隐喻的理论标准；3) 展示期望状态理论和地位建构研究如何提供机制化编码的基础；4) 为组织诊断框架的构建、教学和部署提供新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为实践者提供新的诊断能力类别；2) 帮助识别哪些领导力框架真正可操作；3) 指导如何构建AI友好的组织诊断工具；4) 改进组织冲突分析和干预的实际应用

publicationDetails.detailsText: Charles University in Prague Faculty of Law Research Paper No. 2025/III/5
publicationDetails.journalName: Charles University in Prague Faculty of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This article aims to highlight the links between two new ex ante instruments – mainly the Digital Services Act („DSA“), but to some extent also the Digital Markets Act („DMA“) - with competition and consumer law, as well as the main areas of discussion that have been raised about these regulations during the at that times legislative process and, ultimately, in the expert literature to this day. These include, in particular, the objectives of competition law in digital markets, the "Brussels effect" (and the subsequent "Trump effect"), the advantages and disadvantages of ex-post investigations vs. ex-ante regulation in competition law, the emergence of gatekeepers and very large online platforms and very large internet search engines in European legislation, and the popularized concept of "fairness" for the regulations of digital markets.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了欧盟《数字服务法案》(DSA)和《数字市场法案》(DMA)这两项事前监管工具与竞争法和消费者法的联系，分析了立法过程中及学术文献中的主要讨论议题。
AI.research_question: 欧盟《数字服务法案》(DSA)和《数字市场法案》(DMA)这两项事前监管工具如何与竞争法和消费者法相联系？在立法过程和学术文献中围绕这些法规的主要讨论议题有哪些？
AI.motivation: 随着数字市场的快速发展，传统的事后竞争法执法面临挑战。欧盟引入DSA和DMA作为事前监管工具，需要理清这些新法规与传统竞争法和消费者法的关系，并探讨相关争议议题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争法理论、消费者保护理论、事前监管与事后执法的比较分析、布鲁塞尔效应理论、数字市场守门人理论、公平概念在数字市场规制中的应用。
AI.method: 文献分析法，分析欧盟立法文件、学术文献和专家讨论，对DSA和DMA与竞争法、消费者法的联系进行系统性梳理。
AI.findings: DSA和DMA与竞争法和消费者法存在密切联系；主要讨论议题包括：数字市场竞争法目标、布鲁塞尔效应和特朗普效应、事前监管与事后调查的优劣、守门人和超大在线平台的认定、公平概念在数字市场规制中的应用。
AI.theory_contributions: 阐明了事前监管工具在数字市场规制中的理论定位，分析了布鲁塞尔效应在数字监管领域的表现，探讨了公平概念在竞争法框架下的理论扩展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供DSA和DMA实施的参考框架，帮助企业理解新法规要求，为竞争法执法机构提供事前监管与事后执法的协调思路。

detail.title: The Revolution in Dual Pricing Legal Framework: How the 2022 EU Reform Changed the Rules of the Game Between Online and Offline Sales

publicationDetails.detailsText: Charles University in Prague Faculty of Law Research Paper No. 2025/III/6
publicationDetails.journalName: Charles University in Prague Faculty of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This article analyses the legal framework governing dual pricing in EU competition law, focusing on the transformative changes introduced by the 2022 reform of vertical restraints. Dual pricing refers to suppliers charging distributors different wholesale prices depending on whether products are resold online or offline. Prior to 2022, the European Commission treated dual pricing disadvantaging online sales as a hardcore restriction of competition. However, Commission Regulation (EU) No 2022/720 and the accompanying Vertical Guidelines marked a fundamental shift, recognizing that online sales have matured and acknowledging the legitimate need to incentivize brick-and-mortar investments. Under the current regime, dual pricing is block-exempted if price differences reasonably relate to actual cost and investment differences between channels. This article examines both legal frameworks, the reform's rationales, and decision-making practice at EU level and in Germany, France, and Italy.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了欧盟竞争法中规制双重定价的法律框架，重点关注2022年纵向限制改革带来的变革性变化。双重定价指供应商根据产品在线下或线上转售而向分销商收取不同批发价格。改革后，双重定价在价格差异合理反映渠道间实际成本和投资差异时可获得集体豁免。
AI.research_question: 欧盟竞争法中双重定价的法律框架如何因2022年纵向限制改革而发生变化？改革后双重定价的合法性标准是什么？
AI.motivation: 2022年欧盟纵向限制改革对双重定价的法律规制带来了根本性转变，需要系统分析这一变革及其对欧盟和成员国实践的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟竞争法理论、纵向限制理论、双重定价的经济分析、线上与线下渠道竞争理论
AI.method: 法律框架分析、比较法研究（欧盟、德国、法国、意大利）、案例分析法、政策文件解读
AI.findings: 2022年改革标志着根本性转变：从将不利于线上销售的双重定价视为核心限制，转变为承认线上销售已成熟且需要激励实体店投资。现行制度下，如果价格差异合理反映渠道间实际成本和投资差异，双重定价可获得集体豁免。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对双重定价在竞争法中的理论认识，阐明了线上与线下渠道平衡的经济学原理，为纵向限制理论提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了双重定价合规的明确指引，为执法机构提供了评估标准，有助于平衡线上与线下渠道发展，促进实体店投资。

title: The Venezuela Abstraction: Donald Trump and 4D Chess
affiliations: University of Southern Queensland - Faculty of Business and University of Southern Queensland - Faculty of Business, Education, Law and Arts

detail.title: The Venezuela Abstraction: Donald Trump and 4D Chess
detail.abstract: The military posturing towards Venezuela has many commentators looking for a rationale. When critics argue that President Trump's decisions don't make sense, his supporters say that he's playing four-dimensional (4D) chess. If critics weren't so hopelessly two dimensional, they would see that the President's moves not only make sense but are indeed masterful. And when he wins, the victory is put down to this special type of genius. Of course, it could be that the President is playing a rather simple strategy, or a wrongheaded strategy, while his opponents are looking for a more roundabout decision calculus, even if they suspect that there isn't one. In fact, the very declaration that he is playing 4D chess is itself a move in the game designed to increase the perception of complexity and discombobulate both his opponents and his critics. This is but a special case of that part of the strategy of conflict that might be classified as "getting someone to believe something". But there is, in reality, another dimension to thinking at the upper echelons of business and government. This is a tendency to think abstractly in terms of a certainty that doesn't exist.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了高层决策中的"四维象棋"现象，认为特朗普对委内瑞拉的军事姿态被支持者描述为复杂战略，但实际上可能是简单或错误的策略，而"四维象棋"的说法本身就是一种策略手段，旨在增加对手的困惑。
AI.research_question: 高层决策者（如特朗普总统）是否真的在运用复杂的"四维象棋"战略，还是这种说法本身就是一种迷惑对手的策略？
AI.motivation: 当批评者认为特朗普的决策不合理时，支持者用"四维象棋"来解释其看似混乱的行为，这种现象需要从战略冲突理论的角度进行分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略冲突理论中的"让他人相信某事"策略；高层决策中的抽象思维倾向；认知复杂性理论。
AI.method: 概念分析；案例研究（特朗普对委内瑞拉的军事姿态）；理论推理。
AI.findings: "四维象棋"的说法本身就是一种战略手段，旨在增加对手对决策复杂性的感知并使其困惑；高层决策者倾向于在不存在确定性的情况下进行抽象思考。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了战略冲突理论，提出了"复杂性感知操纵"作为战略工具；揭示了高层决策中抽象思维与实际行动之间的差距。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助决策者识别对手的战略欺骗手段；提醒分析人员不要过度解读简单或错误的策略为复杂战略。

affiliations: Charles University Law Faculty and Faculty of Law, Charles University

detail.title: EU Chips Act as a Challenge for the EU, its Member States and Private Stakeholders

publicationDetails.detailsText: Charles University in Prague Faculty of Law Research Paper No. 2025/III/2
publicationDetails.journalName: Charles University in Prague Faculty of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The new industrial policy and the EU Chips Act as its novel and important instrument bring a number of new elements to the standard concept of the roles of the EU and Member States in promoting industrial development. The key role should henceforth be played not by Member States, their national priorities and money, but by the EU as a whole, represented primarily by the European Commission. At the same time, it brings new methods of central supervision of the development of the chip industry, and especially its central crisis management in case of supply shortages. The article concludes that the EU Chips Act creates sufficient preconditions for the new EU industrial policy not to degenerate into the old competition over who will support and protect the "national industrial champions" more and thus further divide the EU into centre and periphery. It seeks to deduce this not only from the text of the regulation itself, but also from the responses to it in the national semiconductor strategies and position papers of the business associations of the various member countries.

AI.tldr: 欧盟《芯片法案》作为新产业政策工具，改变了欧盟与成员国在促进产业发展中的传统角色分配，强调欧盟整体（特别是欧盟委员会）的主导作用，引入中央监督和危机管理机制，旨在防止成员国各自支持"国家产业冠军"导致欧盟内部分裂。
AI.research_question: 欧盟《芯片法案》如何改变欧盟与成员国在产业政策中的角色分配，以及它是否能有效防止成员国各自支持"国家产业冠军"导致的欧盟内部分裂？
AI.motivation: 传统的欧盟产业政策中，成员国扮演主导角色，各自制定国家优先事项并投入资金支持本国产业，这可能导致成员国之间的竞争和欧盟内部分裂。欧盟《芯片法案》作为新产业政策工具，试图改变这一模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟治理理论、产业政策理论、多层级治理理论、中心-边缘理论（欧盟内部的分裂问题）
AI.method: 文本分析法（分析《芯片法案》法规文本）和内容分析法（分析各成员国半导体战略和商业协会立场文件对法案的回应）
AI.findings: 欧盟《芯片法案》将产业政策主导权从成员国转移到欧盟整体（特别是欧盟委员会），引入中央监督和芯片供应短缺时的危机管理机制，为新的欧盟产业政策创造了足够的前提条件，防止其退化为成员国各自支持"国家产业冠军"的竞争。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了欧盟多层级治理理论，特别是在产业政策领域的权力分配变化；2. 丰富了产业政策理论，探讨了超国家层面产业政策工具的有效性；3. 为中心-边缘理论提供了新的分析视角，探讨如何防止欧盟内部分裂。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为欧盟政策制定者提供了实施新产业政策的框架；2. 为成员国提供了协调国家半导体战略与欧盟整体政策的指导；3. 为企业界提供了理解欧盟产业政策新方向的参考；4. 为其他地区制定类似产业政策提供了借鉴。

detail.title: Memorandum Sent By Invitation To The Justice And Finance Committees Of The Italian Parliament Regarding The Draft Legislative Decree Implementing The 2024 Capital Markets Law

contentType.other: Publicly available document, in Parliamentary records

publicationDetails.detailsText: It has been accepted to appear in the Italian journal Giurisprudenza commerciale.

detail.abstract:
This memorandum provides a critical assessment of the draft legislative decree implementing Italy’s Capital Markets Reform (Law No. 21/2024). While the reform seeks to simplify regulation and stimulate listings, several provisions risk weakening core investor protections and creating constitutional inconsistencies. The most controversial innovation is the optional regime allowing newly listed companies and SMEs to opt out of key safeguards applicable to listed firms—such as slate voting, supermajority requirements, withdrawal rights, and related-party transaction rules. These exemptions could undermine market confidence, distort governance incentives, and expose investors to heightened expropriation risks. The memorandum proposes limiting such flexibility to SMEs, making minority-approval mechanisms both permanent and robust, and excluding high-risk areas—especially related-party transactions—from opt-out eligibility.

Beyond this regime, the decree is deemed overly timid in reducing existing regulatory burdens and, in several respects, introduces new rigidities or unnecessary gold-plating. It also misses the opportunity to modernize the corporate framework for unlisted companies, particularly in ways that would support venture capital and startup growth. Additional concerns relate to takeover rules, delisting procedures, shareholder rights, and supervisory practices. A final warning concerns the Government’s power to issue corrective decrees for two years, possibly without parliamentary review. For democratic and institutional accountability, the Government should be required to submit draft decrees to the competent parliamentary committees. The document is in Italian, with an executive summary in English.

AI.tldr: 本文对意大利资本市场改革实施草案进行了批判性评估，指出其简化监管、刺激上市的目标虽好，但多项条款可能削弱投资者保护并引发宪法不一致问题。最争议的是允许新上市公司和中小企业选择退出关键保护措施的机制，这可能损害市场信心并增加投资者风险。
AI.research_question: 意大利资本市场改革实施草案（第21/2024号法律）在平衡监管简化与投资者保护方面存在哪些关键问题？如何改进草案以更好地实现改革目标？
AI.motivation: 意大利政府通过资本市场改革旨在简化监管、刺激企业上市，但实施草案中的多项条款可能过度削弱投资者保护机制，产生宪法不一致问题，并可能损害市场信心和投资者权益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公司治理理论、投资者保护理论、监管效率理论，分析监管简化与投资者保护之间的平衡关系，以及选择性退出机制对市场信心的影响。
AI.method: 采用法律文本分析法、比较法分析、政策评估方法，对草案条款进行系统性批判性评估，识别宪法不一致、投资者保护削弱等问题。
AI.findings: 1. 选择性退出机制（允许新上市公司和中小企业退出关键保护措施）风险最大；2. 草案在减少监管负担方面过于保守；3. 引入新的僵化规定和不必要的"镀金"条款；4. 错失了为非上市公司现代化公司框架的机会；5. 收购规则、退市程序、股东权利等方面存在额外问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了监管简化与投资者保护平衡的理论框架；2. 分析了选择性退出机制对市场信心的影响机制；3. 探讨了中小企业特殊监管安排的理论基础；4. 贡献于民主问责与监管权力制衡的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议将灵活性限制在中小企业范围内；2. 提议使少数股东批准机制永久化并强化；3. 建议将高风险领域（特别是关联交易）排除在退出资格之外；4. 建议政府草案需提交议会委员会审查；5. 为非上市公司现代化改革提供具体建议。

title: Machine Vision-Based Metal Workpiece Surface Defect Detection System
affiliations: Shenyang Ligong University, Shenyang Ligong University and Shenyang Ligong University

detail.title: Machine Vision-Based Metal Workpiece Surface Defect Detection System
detail.abstract: A metal surface defect detection system that integrates perception guided preprocessing and improved deep learning is proposed to address the diverse shapes and sizes of metal surface defects, which are highly susceptible to noise interference and difficult to achieve high-precision detection standards using existing methods. Firstly, based on the perception of noise characteristics, adaptive hybrid filtering is used to suppress noise, and guided filtering is employed for edge optimization; Adopting the fusion multi-scale gradient adaptive Canny algorithm to accurately extract defect contours. On this basis, the preprocessed and enhanced high-quality images are input into an improved ResNet18 deep network for feature learning and classification. The improved ResNet18 model reconstructs a dedicated classification layer for six typical metal defects, combined with global average pooling, significantly reducing the number of parameters while enhancing the model's generalization ability. The experimental results show that the final detection accuracy of this model is as high as 99.74%, which is 23.8% higher than the baseline model, fully verifying its effectiveness, robustness, and practical value in complex working conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种融合感知引导预处理和改进深度学习的金属表面缺陷检测系统，通过自适应混合滤波和边缘优化处理噪声，采用多尺度梯度自适应Canny算法提取缺陷轮廓，并将预处理后的图像输入改进的ResNet18网络进行分类，最终检测精度达到99.74%，比基线模型提高23.8%。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够有效处理金属表面缺陷多样形状和尺寸、抵抗噪声干扰、实现高精度检测的智能检测系统？
AI.motivation: 金属表面缺陷具有形状和尺寸多样性，易受噪声干扰，现有方法难以达到高精度检测标准，需要开发更有效的检测系统。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 感知引导预处理理论：基于噪声特征感知的自适应混合滤波和引导滤波边缘优化
2. 多尺度梯度自适应Canny算法：融合多尺度信息的轮廓提取方法
3. 改进的ResNet18深度学习框架：结合全局平均池化和专用分类层的网络优化
AI.method:
1. 预处理阶段：采用自适应混合滤波抑制噪声，引导滤波优化边缘，融合多尺度梯度自适应Canny算法提取缺陷轮廓
2. 深度学习阶段：将预处理后的高质量图像输入改进的ResNet18网络，重构专用分类层处理六种典型金属缺陷，结合全局平均池化减少参数
3. 实验验证：通过对比实验评估模型性能
AI.findings:
1. 最终检测精度达到99.74%
2. 比基线模型提高23.8%的检测精度
3. 系统在复杂工况下表现出良好的有效性、鲁棒性和实用价值
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了感知引导预处理与深度学习融合的金属表面缺陷检测框架
2. 发展了自适应混合滤波和引导滤波的边缘优化方法
3. 改进了ResNet18网络结构，通过全局平均池化和专用分类层设计提升了模型泛化能力
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 开发了高精度（99.74%）的金属表面缺陷检测系统
2. 系统能够有效处理噪声干扰和缺陷多样性问题
3. 为工业质检提供了实用的自动化检测解决方案
4. 显著提升了检测效率和准确性，适用于复杂工业环境

title: Industrial Competitiveness and Innovation: A Comprehensive Analysis of Globally Engaged Taiwan-Listed Companies
affiliations: University of Liège - HEC-Liège, Management School of the University of Liège

detail.title: Industrial Competitiveness and Innovation: A Comprehensive Analysis of Globally Engaged Taiwan-Listed Companies

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. The research was conducted independently without any commercial or financial relationships that could be construed as a potential conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or personal data collection. Therefore, formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted as part of the author’s Executive Doctorate in Business Administration (EDBA) at HEC Liège, Belgium.

detail.abstract: Taiwan's electronics industry, pivotal to its economic and global competitiveness, faces challenges from rapid technological advancements, shifting markets, and intensified competition. While innovation is recognized as key to maintaining competitiveness, the interplay of corporate governance, organizational culture, and sustainability with innovation strategies remains underexplored. This study aims to identify the drivers of competitiveness among Taiwan-listed electronics companies through a comprehensive analysis of financial, governance, and innovation-related variables, leveraging extensive nationwide longitudinal data and advanced analytical methods with machine learning algorithm. A mixed-methods approach was employed, combining quantitative analysis of longitudinal data from sources like the Taiwan Economic Journal Pro (TEJ) and Market Observation Post System (MOPS) with qualitative insights from interviews and case studies. Random forest models, regression analyses, and thematic evaluations of corporate practices were integrated to derive actionable insights. The results of innovation & financial performance indicate that companies with high R&D expenditure and active patenting strategies demonstrate superior market valuation and operational efficiency. For instance, firms with an R&D intensity above 8% recorded a Tobin's Q ratio of 1.45 compared to 1.12 for lower R&D investments. As for patent activity, results show that patent-rich companies exhibited higher operating margins and competitive advantages. The applied machine learning method of random forest models identified patent activity as a primary predictor of financial success. In the category of global presence, firms with significant overseas investments achieved an annual revenue growth of 11.8%, significantly outpacing their domestically-focused peers. For the corporate governance results, the transparent governance structures and sustainability-focused policies correlated with improved innovation outputs and competitive edge. The integration of innovation, governance, and culture underscores the importance of holistic strategies in achieving global competitiveness. dynamic capabilities, collaborative practices, and adaptive governance are pivotal in sustaining market relevance. In sum, this study underscores the necessity for Taiwanese firms to invest in R&D, strengthen governance, and foster innovative cultures to remain globally competitive. Future research could explore sector-specific dynamics and long-term impacts of global challenges.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过混合方法分析台湾上市电子公司的财务、治理和创新变量，发现高研发投入、活跃专利策略、透明治理结构和可持续发展政策是提升竞争力的关键驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 台湾上市电子公司竞争力的驱动因素是什么？公司治理、组织文化、可持续性与创新策略如何相互作用影响竞争力？
AI.motivation: 台湾电子产业对其经济和全球竞争力至关重要，但面临技术快速进步、市场变化和竞争加剧的挑战。虽然创新被认为是保持竞争力的关键，但公司治理、组织文化、可持续性与创新策略之间的相互作用尚未得到充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态能力理论、创新理论、公司治理理论、可持续发展理论
AI.method: 混合方法：结合台湾经济新报(TEJ)和市场观察站系统(MOPS)的纵向数据定量分析，以及访谈和案例研究的定性洞察。使用随机森林模型、回归分析和企业实践的主题评估。
AI.findings: 1. 高研发投入（强度>8%）的公司托宾Q值为1.45，高于低研发投入公司的1.12；2. 专利丰富的公司表现出更高的营业利润率和竞争优势；3. 随机森林模型识别专利活动为财务成功的主要预测因子；4. 海外投资显著的公司年收入增长11.8%；5. 透明治理结构和可持续发展政策与创新产出和竞争优势正相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 整合公司治理、组织文化和可持续性对创新策略的影响；2. 验证动态能力理论在电子产业的应用；3. 提供创新、治理和文化协同作用的实证证据；4. 扩展竞争力驱动因素的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为台湾电子公司提供具体的竞争力提升策略：增加研发投资、强化专利策略、拓展全球布局、改善治理结构；2. 识别关键绩效指标和预测因子；3. 为政策制定者提供产业升级建议；4. 提供可操作的管理洞察。

detail.abstract: The relationship between SMEs' innovation performance and Open Innovation search strategies is a highly discussed topic in the literature. Nevertheless, past studies rarely consider whether this relationship is moderated by Big Data characteristics. Drawing on the transaction costs theory, we hypothesize that Big Data Value and Big Data Veracity may moderate the relationship between OI search strategies (OI breadth and depth) and SMEs' radical and incremental innovation performance by respectively increasing and decreasing the coordination costs emerging in this relationship. Through a unique dataset of Italian SMEs, our study shows a significant moderating impact of Big Data Value, suggesting a reduction of transaction and coordination costs that improves efficiency in SMEs' open innovation. On the basis of these findings, we provide some theoretical and managerial implications.

title: Sustaining Punjab's Food Security Amid Rapid Population Growth: A Policy Brief
affiliations: and University of Sargodha, Sargodha Punjab, Pakistan

detail.title: Sustaining Punjab's Food Security Amid Rapid Population Growth: A Policy Brief
detail.abstract: Punjab's rapid population growth has exerted considerable pressure on food systems, exacerbating challenges related to production, distribution, and equitable access, particularly among vulnerable populations. This policy brief synthesizes evidence-based insights to inform actionable strategies aimed at mitigating these impacts. Recommended interventions include the expansion of family planning programs and public awareness initiatives to moderate demographic pressures; the adoption of nutrition-sensitive agricultural practices to enhance food security; the integration of comprehensive health and sex education to support informed household decision-making; and the reinforcement of social safety nets to protect at-risk communities. Furthermore, effective inter-sectoral coordination among governmental bodies, non-governmental organizations, and local stakeholders is essential for sustainable implementation. Collectively, these measures offer a framework for policymakers to address the nexus of population dynamics and food insecurity, strengthen community resilience, and advance long-term sustainable development in Punjab.

title: Investor Psychology and Structural DNA: Why Capital Now Chases Philosophy-Driven Companies
affiliations: Hoopoe Holding Ltd.

detail.title: Investor Psychology and Structural DNA: Why Capital Now Chases Philosophy-Driven Companies
detail.abstract: A quiet but decisive transformation is redefining the language of capital. Investors are beginning to favor coherence over calculation, meaning over metrics. The age of pure rational finance has given way to an era in which philosophical alignment and structural integrity outweigh short-term yield. In markets saturated with data and automation, capital now seeks what algorithms cannot simulate: authenticity of design, consistency of ethics, and clarity of thought. This paper examines that shift from analytical to cognitive and ontological capitalism and introduces the concept of Structural DNA: the invisible architecture of belief and design logic that sustains an organization's long-term coherence. Capital, I argue, is evolving into a cognitive force that rewards integrity of structure more than volume of return. The next decade will belong to companies whose philosophical design can be measured, not merely marketed.

detail.title: Aligning Entrepreneurial Strategy

publicationDetails.detailsText: Columbia Business School Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: Columbia Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Strategic fit is intrinsic to firm performance, but it is difficult to develop and maintain both external fit to a firm's environment, and internal fit—an alignment between firm objectives and activities. In this paper, we examine how scaling entrepreneurial firms develop strategic fit. We theorize that: 1) entrepreneurs at scaling firms are experienced in developing external, product-market fit, yet inexperienced in developing internal fit; 2) entrepreneurs can use firm strategy to create heuristics and assess the internal fit of novel opportunities. We examined the prevalence of internal fit by leveraging interviews with entrepreneurs in 253 global scaling software startups and coding close to 1,000 firm decisions using large language models (LLMs). Internal fit was strongly associated with firm performance, but only one-third of firms had developed this fit. We examined whether entrepreneurs could create heuristics to assess internal fit by running an experiment with 241 different entrepreneurs with whom we shared multiple novel opportunities. Midway through, we prompted entrepreneurs to pause and articulate their firm strategy. Post-intervention, entrepreneurs screened out opportunities that did not internally fit, without reducing their pursuit of those that fit. We provide initial evidence in support of our theory, suggesting that entrepreneurs can rapidly create heuristics to drive internal fit, which is important for firm scaling.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨创业公司在规模化过程中如何发展战略匹配，发现内部匹配（公司目标与活动的协调）对绩效至关重要但只有三分之一公司具备，通过实验证明创业者可以通过明确公司战略来创建启发式方法评估机会的内部匹配性。
AI.research_question: 创业公司在规模化过程中如何发展战略匹配？特别是，创业者如何评估和实现内部匹配（公司目标与活动的协调）？
AI.motivation: 战略匹配对绩效至关重要，但创业公司在规模化过程中面临挑战：创业者通常擅长发展外部产品市场匹配，但缺乏发展内部匹配的经验。研究如何帮助创业者有效评估机会的内部匹配性对创业成功和规模化具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略匹配理论（外部匹配与内部匹配）、创业决策理论、启发式决策理论、公司战略作为评估框架的理论
AI.method: 混合方法研究：1）对253家全球规模化软件创业公司的创业者进行访谈，使用大语言模型编码近1000个公司决策；2）对241名创业者进行实验，中途干预要求他们明确公司战略，观察干预前后对机会内部匹配的评估变化
AI.findings: 1）内部匹配与公司绩效强相关；2）只有三分之一的企业发展了内部匹配；3）创业者通过明确公司战略可以创建启发式方法，有效筛选出不符合内部匹配的机会，同时不减少对匹配机会的追求
AI.theory_contributions: 1）扩展了战略匹配理论在创业情境中的应用；2）提出了公司战略作为启发式框架的理论机制；3）为创业决策理论提供了实证支持，展示创业者如何通过学习发展内部匹配能力
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为创业者提供了实用的工具和方法来评估机会的内部匹配性；2）通过简单的"暂停并明确战略"干预就能显著改善决策质量；3）帮助创业公司在规模化过程中更有效地发展内部匹配，提高成功概率

detail.abstract: Patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) and patient-reported experience measures (PREMs) are increasingly used to evaluate care quality; however, the patient’s perspective is still not frequently used to evaluate chronic care pathways. We present the design of a patient-reported systematic and longitudinal data collection for patients with diabetes. Pre-test results of the baseline questionnaire are also described. We verified the readability and clarity of questions and the completeness or redundancy of items. The study design resulted from a collaborative process with professionals (patient-reported scale selection and definition of time points for data collection) and patients (pre-test). Two scales were selected as PROMs, while PREMs were designed to evaluate different dimensions of patients’ experience along the care pathways. Some items on self-care were also included. A paper-based pre-test was initially conducted in three ambulatory care services. The systematic data collection will then be implemented with a web-based platform. The questionnaire was clearly designed and usable. Based on the pre-test, researchers changed some wording and reordered questions to implement an improved version in the systematic data collection. The preliminary results on outcomes and experience of care are available to professionals to support improving the delivery of care to patients with diabetes. The collaborative process with healthcare professionals and patients was effective and contributed to guaranteeing that systematic data collected will support the monitoring and evaluation of care services’ organizational models for diabetic patients.

AI.tldr: 该研究设计了一个针对糖尿病患者的患者报告系统纵向数据收集方案，通过专业人员与患者协作过程开发问卷，并进行预测试验证可用性，最终将实施基于网络平台的系统数据收集以支持糖尿病护理服务的监测与评估。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个有效的患者报告系统纵向数据收集方案来评估糖尿病慢性护理路径的质量？
AI.motivation: 虽然患者报告结局指标(PROMs)和患者报告体验指标(PREMs)越来越多地用于评估护理质量，但患者的视角在评估慢性护理路径时仍不常用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于患者报告结局指标(PROMs)和患者报告体验指标(PREMs)的理论框架，结合慢性病护理路径评估的需求。
AI.method: 采用协作式研究方法：1)与专业人员合作选择患者报告量表并确定数据收集时间点；2)与患者进行预测试；3)在三家门诊服务中进行纸质预测试；4)后续实施基于网络平台的系统数据收集。
AI.findings: 问卷设计清晰可用，基于预测试结果修改了部分措辞并重新排序问题；选择了两个量表作为PROMs，设计了评估护理路径不同维度患者体验的PREMs，并包含自我护理项目；协作过程有效保证了系统数据收集能够支持糖尿病护理服务组织模式的监测与评估。
AI.theory_contributions: 为慢性病护理路径评估提供了结合PROMs和PREMs的系统数据收集框架，展示了专业人员与患者协作在工具开发中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了可用于糖尿病护理质量评估的实用工具，为专业人员提供了改善糖尿病护理交付的初步结果，建立了支持护理服务组织模式监测与评估的系统数据收集平台。

detail.abstract:
Globalization, technological development, and economic expansion have made living more comfortable and luxurious, but they have also resulted in a considerable loss of biodiversity, environmental degradation from climate change, resource depletion, and loss of greenery. Sustainable development and environmental preservation are seen as essential stages in the preservation of our world. Change is essential for survival, and continuing attempts to manage the environment responsibly must be made. title: Regenerative Architecture Thinking: A Design Discipline for Temporal, Institutional, and Capital Systems

detail.title: Regenerative Architecture Thinking: A Design Discipline for Temporal, Institutional, and Capital Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This research was conducted independently and was not influenced by financial, political, or organisational interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research does not involve human subjects, clinical data, or identifiable personal information. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency, commercial entity, or not-for-profit organisation.

detail.abstract: Regenerative Architecture Thinking (RAT) is proposed as a general design discipline for the construction of long-horizon societal systems. Contemporary institutions routinely fail not because they lack capital or capability, but because their architectures are governed by short, volatile temporal structures misaligned with multi-decadal mission demands. RAT integrates systems theory, institutional economics, regenerative capital design, and architectural method to provide a unified framework for designing temporal, capital, and governance structures. We formalise regenerative systems, define the operators that govern temporal integrity, and introduce the Regenerative Architecture Method (RAM) for analysing and redesigning societal operating systems. RAT encompasses and generalises recent advances in Perpetual Social Capital (PSC), Regenerative Cycle Architecture (RCA), and Alignment Capital (AC), positioning architecture—not policy or incentives—as the central determinant of institutional behaviour. Applications across capital, climate, science, health, markets, and governance illustrate its generality and necessity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出再生建筑思维(RAT)作为构建长期社会系统的通用设计学科，强调建筑结构而非政策或激励是制度行为的核心决定因素。
AI.research_question: 如何设计能够支持多十年使命需求的社会系统架构，避免因短期波动的时间结构与长期需求不匹配而导致制度失败？
AI.motivation: 当代制度经常失败不是因为缺乏资本或能力，而是因为其架构受短期波动的时间结构支配，与多十年的使命需求不匹配。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统理论、制度经济学、再生资本设计、建筑方法，整合为统一的时间、资本和治理结构设计框架。
AI.method: 提出再生建筑方法(RAM)，用于分析和重新设计社会操作系统；形式化再生系统，定义管理时间完整性的操作符。
AI.findings: RAT包含并概括了永续社会资本(PSC)、再生循环架构(RCA)和协调资本(AC)等最新进展，将建筑定位为制度行为的核心决定因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出再生建筑思维作为通用设计学科；2) 形式化再生系统理论；3) 建立时间完整性管理框架；4) 将建筑而非政策或激励定位为制度行为的核心。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供RAM方法应用于资本、气候、科学、健康、市场和治理等领域，为设计长期可持续的社会系统提供实用工具。

title: Application of the Balanced Scorecard for Risk and Emergency Management in the Paraíba Valley and North Coast of São Paulo

detail.title: Application of the Balanced Scorecard for Risk and Emergency Management in the Paraíba Valley and North Coast of São Paulo
detail.abstract: The Paraíba Valley and North Coast region of São Paulo presents significant challenges in risk and emergency management due to its population density, road infrastructure, hospital capacity, and diverse range of potential natural and technological risks. This study proposes the application of the Balanced Scorecard (BSC) as a strategic tool for monitoring and mitigating risks, integrating performance indicators across financial, internal processes, learning and growth, and citizen perspectives. The survey considers the population density of municipalities, the capacity of major highways, the availability of hospital beds, and the main regional risks, including energy, natural disasters, and technology. The methodology is based on the analysis of secondary data and the cross-referencing of strategic information to propose a more efficient and responsive management model.

title: Credential Downgrading as Fiscal Boundary Work: An X–Y Analysis of the 2025 U.S. “Professional Degree” Reclassification
affiliations: Ontario Institute for Studies in Education (OISE), University of Toronto

detail.title: Credential Downgrading as Fiscal Boundary Work: An X–Y Analysis of the 2025 U.S. “Professional Degree” Reclassification

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No external or institutional funding was used for this research
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: This study relies solely on publicly accessible regulatory and fiscal materials and did not require research ethics board approval.

detail.abstract:
This paper examines a recent U.S. policy move that reclassified several long-standing professional degrees—including nursing, social work, education, accounting, architecture, physical therapy, audiology, and physician assistant programs—as non-professional in federal regulatory language and public media reporting. Rather than interpreting the shift as a symbolic dispute over naming, the paper treats the reclassification as a fiscal event that alters how a core segment of the U.S. tax base is positioned within federal and state fiscal structures.
Using a two-axis fiscal framework, the analysis traces how the downgrade affects horizontal fiscal position (X), including wage classification, licensure access, student-loan programs, and eligibility for credit-based transfers such as the Earned Income Tax Credit and Child Tax Credit. It then examines how the same shift compresses downward post-tax capacity (Y), shaping debt burdens, early-career income trajectories, and the resources available to support dependents over time.
Drawing on credential sociology (Collins), public reporting, and official tax documentation, the paper maps these rule–capital interactions into an X–Y fiscal plane to show how credential categories function not only as labor-market boundaries but also as coordinates within the U.S. fiscal grid.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了美国将多个传统专业学位（护理、社会工作、教育、会计等）重新分类为非专业学位的政策变化，将其视为财政事件而非象征性命名争议。研究使用双轴财政框架，追踪这一降级如何影响横向财政地位（工资分类、执照获取、学生贷款项目等）和压缩税后能力（债务负担、早期职业收入轨迹等）。
AI.research_question: 美国将传统专业学位重新分类为非专业学位的政策变化如何影响这些学位持有者在联邦和州财政结构中的财政地位和税后能力？

AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 双轴财政框架：横向财政地位（X轴）和税后能力（Y轴）
2. 证书社会学（Collins的理论）
3. 规则-资本互动分析框架
AI.method:
1. 使用双轴财政框架进行分析
2. 结合公共报道和官方税务文件
3. 将规则-资本互动映射到X-Y财政平面
4. 分析横向财政地位（工资分类、执照获取、学生贷款项目、税收抵免资格等）
5. 分析税后能力压缩（债务负担、早期职业收入轨迹、抚养资源等）
AI.findings:
1. 学位重新分类改变了这些职业在财政结构中的定位
2. 影响横向财政地位：工资分类、执照获取、学生贷款资格、税收抵免资格
3. 压缩税后能力：增加债务负担、影响早期收入轨迹、减少抚养资源
4. 证书类别不仅是劳动力市场边界，也是美国财政网格中的坐标
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将证书重新分类概念化为财政事件而非象征性争议
2. 开发了分析证书类别财政影响的双轴框架
3. 展示了证书如何作为财政网格中的坐标运作
4. 扩展了证书社会学的应用范围
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 揭示了政策变化对专业学位持有者的实际财政影响
2. 为政策制定者提供了评估类似重新分类影响的框架
3. 帮助受影响职业群体理解其财政地位变化
4. 为相关利益相关者提供了决策依据

title: Challenges to the Implementation of Capacity-Building Measures Under Climate Change Law in Kenya
affiliations: University of Nairobi, University of Nairobi and University of Nairobi

detail.title: Challenges to the Implementation of Capacity-Building Measures Under Climate Change Law in Kenya

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This is to declare that this research has not benefited from any person or organisation that may have or could be perceived to have influenced it.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Approved by the National Research Council of Kenya
declarations.funderStatement: The research was self-funded as a Master of Arts degree in environmental law at the University of Nairobi

detail.abstract: Kenya has a higher vulnerability to climate change, which ranks it at 151 globally out of 181 in the 2019 ND-GAIN Index, due to its position and location in the Horn of Africa. It is projected that more rain, worse droughts and the emergence of drug-resistant diseases will be experienced in the coming decades, especially over the next 30 years, if little is done to improve resilience and adaptive capacity. On this basis, capacity building, among other measures, has been recommended as an enabler of climate change action, including resilience building. Guided by Hans Kelsen’s legal positivism theory, this study sought to assess how capacity-building measures have been included and implemented under Kenya’s climate change law regime, with Kisumu County serving as a case study. The study covered four areas: (1) assessment of capacity building mandates, (2) how various climate change actors are fulfilling their mandates, (3) barriers and opportunities and (4) options for strengthening capacity development. The data collection exercise involved the review of literature and key informant interviews. A purposeful sampling procedure was used to identify participants. The study established that capacity building is progressing moderately at institutional, systemic and individual levels. Legal frameworks exist, institutions have been established, and actors are active, but with varied capacities and approaches to capacity building. There exist challenges too: limited finances, inadequate skills, low awareness, weak coordination, lack of incentives, limited data and competition among global institutions. As we advance, the study recommends the development of a locally-led, need-based, multi-sector, and multi-stakeholder framework for capacity building for climate action at national and county levels.

title: Exploring Barriers to Metaverse-Enabled Healthcare 4.0 Patient Monitoring Using Interval-Valued Pythagorean Fuzzy DEMATEL
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Tunghai University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Exploring Barriers to Metaverse-Enabled Healthcare 4.0 Patient Monitoring Using Interval-Valued Pythagorean Fuzzy DEMATEL
detail.abstract: The merging of immersive technologies with real-time clinical data in healthcare 4.0 significantly transforms patient monitoring and management in the metaverse. This study systematically reviews the applications of the Metaverse technologies in health care. Study further advances to examine the challenges of adopting metaverse-enabled healthcare systems using an Interval-Valued Pythagorean Fuzzy Decision-Making Trial and Evaluation Laboratory (IVPF-DEMATEL) framework. For the evaluation of the challenges, this work considers inputs based on evidence received from the experts of a prominent healthcare institution in Western Maharashtra, India. A systematic literature review identified 12 critical challenges across technical, regulatory, social, and economic domains. Expert-based IVPF-DEMATEL evaluations revealed that data security and privacy, infrastructure and interoperability, and regulatory compliance are the most prominent and causative barriers. User experience, cultural acceptance, and sustainability concerns largely emerge as downstream effects. The causal–effect analysis highlights the hierarchical structure of these barriers, demonstrating that addressing core technical and regulatory issues will generate positive ripple effects across user-centric and socio-cultural dimensions. The findings provide actionable insights for policymakers, healthcare managers, and technology developers, underscoring the need for secure, interoperable, and ethically governed digital ecosystems to realise the transformative potential of the metaverse in healthcare. This study contributes to the growing body of healthcare 4.0 research by offering empirical evidence from the Indian context and proposing strategic directions for sustainable and equitable adoption of immersive patient care technologies.

title: Rethinking Merit: Identity-Shaped Experience Qualification

detail.title: Rethinking Merit: Identity-Shaped Experience Qualification
detail.abstract: In the wake of Students for Fair Admissions v. Harvard and recent executive orders restricting diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives, institutions are told to rely only on "merit." Yet merit is not neutral or fixed; it is socially constructed and has long reflected race, class, and gender hierarchies. This Article argues that identity-shaped experiences, particularly those forged in navigating racialized structures, are themselves a form of merit. Such experiences cultivate resilience, adaptability, institutional navigation, and leadership: competencies universities and employers already say they value. The claim is not that racial identity warrants preference, but that the experience of being racialized, when coupled with insight and growth, produces qualifications directly relevant to institutional success. Doctrinally, this framework fits within Title VII and Equal Protection, both of which permit individualized assessments that consider lived experience. By developing a competence-based approach to merit, this Article offers institutions a legally viable and ethically sound way to reconcile equity and merit in the post-SFFA era.

AI.tldr: 本文主张种族身份相关的经历本身就是一种"优点"，这些经历培养了适应力、领导力等能力，为机构提供了一种在平权法案受限后合法且符合伦理的多元化路径。

AI.theoretical_framework: 优点作为社会建构的理论；种族身份经历作为能力培养的理论；法律框架下的个体化评估理论。
AI.method: 法律分析、理论论证、概念框架构建。
AI.findings: 种族身份相关的经历培养了适应力、制度导航能力和领导力等能力，这些能力本身就是优点；这种框架符合Title VII和平等保护条款。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于能力的优点概念框架，将种族身份经历重新定义为制度成功相关的资格。
AI.practical_contributions: 为机构提供了在SFFA后时代合法且符合伦理的路径，将公平与优点相协调。

AI.research_question: QR码点餐系统在高流量美食广场中的顾客和员工体验如何？包括使用便捷性、时间节省效果、与传统点餐方式的偏好比较，以及对员工工作流程的影响。
AI.motivation: 随着数字点餐系统在餐饮业的普及，需要了解QR码点餐在实际高流量环境中的实际效果，为酒店餐饮运营商提供实施数字点餐系统的实践指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主要基于服务创新采纳理论、技术接受模型(TAM)和工作流程优化理论，关注数字技术在餐饮服务中的应用效果。
AI.method: 采用案例研究方法，在拉斯维加斯Aria赌场Proper Eats美食广场进行实地调查，通过问卷调查5位不同人口统计特征的顾客和3位员工，评估QR码点餐系统的多方面体验。
AI.findings: 研究发现提供了QR码点餐系统在高流量环境中的实际效果数据，包括顾客使用体验、时间节省程度、与传统点餐的偏好对比，以及系统对员工工作流程的具体影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了数字技术在餐饮服务采纳的理论研究，特别是在高流量环境下的应用效果，为技术接受模型在餐饮业的实证研究提供了新案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 为酒店餐饮运营商提供了实施数字点餐系统的实用洞察，包括系统设计、员工培训和工作流程优化建议，帮助提高运营效率和顾客满意度。

title: The Generation of Boundaries: The Theoretical Foundations of Ye Jie and the Fourth Phase
affiliations: Fan Ge Institute

detail.title: The Generation of Boundaries: The Theoretical Foundations of Ye Jie and the Fourth Phase
detail.abstract: This paper introduces Ye Jie (也 界), a new conceptual framework proposed by Fan Ge to describe the generative space that arises at the boundary between systems, phases, or domains. Unlike conventional notions of boundaries as fixed separations, Ye Jie denotes a self-generating boundary field in which differentiation, tension, and energy exchange give rise to new structural orders. Philosophically rooted in the Buddhist notion of Nirvāṇa and scientifically aligned with thermodynamics, chaos theory, and evolutionary dynamics, Ye Jie bridges metaphysical inquiry with scientific modeling. The paper further identifies the Fourth Phase-the physical analogue of Ye Jie-as the operational field of innovation, where new patterns of order emerge from nonequilibrium conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"也界"这一新概念框架，用于描述系统、阶段或领域之间边界处产生的生成性空间。与传统的固定边界概念不同，也界表示一个自我生成的边界场，其中分化、张力和能量交换产生新的结构秩序。
AI.research_question: 如何概念化和描述系统、阶段或领域之间边界处产生的生成性空间？这种边界空间如何促进新结构秩序的出现？
AI.motivation: 传统边界概念通常将边界视为固定的分隔线，但实际中边界往往是动态的、生成性的空间。需要一个新的概念框架来描述这种边界处的创新和秩序生成过程。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 佛教涅槃概念（哲学基础）
2. 热力学（能量交换和非平衡条件）
3. 混沌理论（复杂系统行为）
4. 演化动力学（新秩序的出现）
5. 第四相理论（物理类比）
AI.method: 概念分析框架构建：通过跨学科的概念整合，将佛教哲学概念与自然科学理论相结合，提出"也界"这一新的概念框架。
AI.findings:
1. "也界"是一个自我生成的边界场，其中分化、张力和能量交换产生新的结构秩序
2. 第四相是"也界"的物理类比，作为创新的操作场域
3. 新秩序模式从非平衡条件中涌现
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出"也界"这一新的概念框架，丰富了边界理论
2. 建立了佛教哲学与自然科学之间的桥梁
3. 为理解创新和秩序生成过程提供了新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为创新管理提供了新的概念工具
2. 为理解复杂系统中的变革过程提供了框架
3. 为跨学科研究提供了方法论启示

title: Determine the Factors Affecting Students Buying Behavior: A Study in Rajshahi University
affiliations: University of Rajshahi, University of Rajshahi, University of Rajshahi and University of Rajshahi

detail.title: Determine the Factors Affecting Students Buying Behavior: A Study in Rajshahi University
detail.abstract: The purpose of this paper is to identify the factors that affect or influence the buying behavior of students at Rajshahi University, and to determine which factors have the most significant impact. The researchers developed a structured questionnaire covering various variables, including demographic factors, buying preferences, influencing and motivational factors, as well as payment methods and budgeting behavior. A pilot survey was conducted among 16 students to refine the questionnaire based on a literature review. Following the pilot, additional relevant questions were added. The final questionnaire was distributed among 600 students from different departments using random sampling. The study found that Influence and Motivation and Demographic Factors significantly influence students’ buying behavior. However, Buying Preference and Payment and Budgeting did not show significant direct effects. Furthermore, the moderating effects of Demographic Factors on the relationships between the independent variables (BP, IM, PB) and student buying behavior were found to be non-significant. The findings have several practical implications for marketers, businesses, and even the university. Marketers can use the insights to craft more effective, student-friendly advertising strategies. Businesses can adjust their distribution plans, pricing, and product offerings to better target the student market. Overall, the study enhances understanding of student consumer behavior, enabling stakeholders to make more informed decisions.

AI.tldr: 本研究识别了影响Rajshahi大学学生购买行为的因素，发现影响与动机因素和人口统计因素对学生购买行为有显著影响，而购买偏好、支付与预算因素无显著直接影响。人口统计因素的调节作用也不显著。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素影响Rajshahi大学学生的购买行为？哪些因素具有最显著的影响？
AI.motivation: 理解学生消费行为对于营销人员、企业和大学制定有效策略至关重要。学生市场具有独特的消费特征和潜力，需要专门研究来指导相关决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费者行为理论，研究考察了人口统计因素、购买偏好、影响与动机因素、支付与预算行为等变量对学生购买行为的影响。
AI.method: 采用结构化问卷调查法。首先通过文献综述和16名学生的预调查完善问卷，然后使用随机抽样方法向600名不同院系的学生发放最终问卷。
AI.findings:
1. 影响与动机因素和人口统计因素对学生购买行为有显著影响
2. 购买偏好、支付与预算因素无显著直接影响
3. 人口统计因素对自变量（购买偏好、影响与动机、支付与预算）与学生购买行为之间关系的调节作用不显著
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 验证了影响与动机因素在学生消费行为中的核心作用
2. 揭示了人口统计因素作为直接影响因素而非调节变量的作用
3. 提供了发展中国家学生消费行为的实证证据
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为营销人员制定更有效的学生友好型广告策略提供依据
2. 帮助企业调整分销计划、定价和产品供应以更好地瞄准学生市场
3. 为大学理解学生消费模式提供参考，支持相关决策制定

title: Climate Change Actors and their Capacity-Building Roles under Climate Change Law
affiliations: University of Nairobi, University of Nairobi and University of Nairobi

detail.title: Climate Change Actors and their Capacity-Building Roles under Climate Change Law
detail.abstract: Kenya has a higher vulnerability to climate change, which ranks it at 151 globally out of 181 in the 2019 ND-GAIN Index, due to its position and location in the Horn of Africa. It is projected that more rain, worse droughts and the emergence of drug-resistant diseases will be experienced in the coming decades, especially over the next 30 years, if little is done to improve resilience and adaptive capacity. On this basis, capacity building, among other measures, has been recommended as an enabler of climate change action, including resilience building. Guided by Hans Kelsen’s legal positivism theory, this study sought to assess how capacity-building measures have been included and implemented under Kenya’s climate change law regime, with Kisumu County serving as a case study. The study covered four areas: (1) assessment of capacity building mandates, (2) how various climate change actors are fulfilling their mandates, (3) barriers and opportunities and (4) options for strengthening capacity development. The data collection exercise involved the review of literature and key informant interviews. A purposeful sampling procedure was used to identify participants. The study established that capacity building is progressing moderately at institutional, systemic and individual levels. Legal frameworks exist, institutions have been established, and actors are active, but with varied capacities and approaches to capacity building. There exist challenges too: limited finances, inadequate skills, low awareness, weak coordination, lack of incentives, limited data and competition among global institutions. As we advance, the study recommends the development of a locally-led, need-based, multi-sector, and multi-stakeholder framework for capacity building for climate action at national and county levels.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了肯尼亚气候变化法律体系中能力建设措施的纳入和实施情况，以基苏木县为案例。研究发现能力建设在制度、系统和个人层面进展中等，存在法律框架和机构，但面临资金不足、技能欠缺、协调薄弱等挑战，建议制定本地主导、需求导向的多部门多利益相关方能力建设框架。
AI.research_question: 肯尼亚气候变化法律体系中能力建设措施如何被纳入和实施？
AI.motivation: 肯尼亚在2019年ND-GAIN指数中排名151/181，对气候变化高度脆弱，未来几十年将面临更多降雨、更严重干旱和耐药性疾病，需要加强适应能力和韧性建设。
AI.theoretical_framework: 汉斯·凯尔森的法律实证主义理论
AI.method: 文献综述和关键信息人访谈，采用目的性抽样程序识别参与者
AI.findings: 能力建设在制度、系统和个人层面进展中等；存在法律框架和机构，行动者活跃但能力不同；面临资金有限、技能不足、意识低、协调弱、缺乏激励、数据有限和全球机构竞争等挑战
AI.theory_contributions: 将法律实证主义理论应用于气候变化能力建设评估，为发展中国家气候变化法律实施研究提供理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 建议制定本地主导、需求导向、多部门、多利益相关方的能力建设框架，为国家层面和县级气候变化行动提供具体实施方案

title: How AI and AR Shape Decision Confidence in Cross-Border E-Commerce: A Hybrid SEM–Machine Learning Approach
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Science and Technology Beijing, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: How AI and AR Shape Decision Confidence in Cross-Border E-Commerce: A Hybrid SEM–Machine Learning Approach
detail.abstract: Cross-border e-commerce (CBEC) in emerging markets is characterized by trust deficits, perceived purchase risk, and high product return rates. This study examines how artificial intelligence features (AIF) and augmented reality features (ARF) enhance consumers’ decision confidence (DC) in Pakistan’s CBEC context, using Alibaba’s digital feature strategy as a benchmark for Daraz. A hybrid empirical design is employed: partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) estimates causal relationships, and machine-learning models (Random Forest, Logistic Regression) assess predictive robustness. Results show that product category complexity (PCC) and technology readiness (TR) significantly increase adoption of AI and AR features. AI exerts the strongest positive effect on DC, while AR provides an additional but comparatively smaller effect. PCC influences DC indirectly through digital feature use, whereas TR exhibits both direct and mediated effects. Machine-learning explainability methods (feature importance and SHAP) corroborate these findings, confirming the dominance of AI features and TR while uncovering nonlinear and interaction patterns not captured by SEM alone. The study extends TAM and TTF by positioning DC as a post-adoption assurance outcome and by integrating causal explanation with predictive validation. Managerially, the findings highlight the value of explainable AI, readiness-building UX, and feature-rich product pages to strengthen consumer confidence and reduce return behavior in CBEC environments.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨在巴基斯坦跨境电子商务环境中，人工智能功能(AIF)和增强现实功能(ARF)如何通过提升消费者决策信心(DC)来应对信任赤字和退货率高的挑战。研究发现产品类别复杂性(PCC)和技术准备度(TR)显著促进AI和AR功能采用，其中AI对DC影响最强，AR影响相对较小。研究采用PLS-SEM和机器学习模型相结合的方法，验证了AI功能和技术准备度的主导作用。
AI.research_question: 在巴基斯坦跨境电子商务环境中，人工智能功能(AIF)和增强现实功能(ARF)如何影响消费者决策信心(DC)？产品类别复杂性(PCC)和技术准备度(TR)如何调节数字功能的采用？
AI.motivation: 新兴市场跨境电子商务面临信任赤字、感知购买风险和高退货率的挑战。需要研究数字技术如何增强消费者信心，减少退货行为，促进跨境电子商务发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术接受模型(TAM)和任务技术匹配理论(TTF)，将决策信心定位为采纳后的保证结果，整合因果解释与预测验证。
AI.method: 采用混合实证设计：1) 偏最小二乘结构方程模型(PLS-SEM)估计因果关系；2) 机器学习模型(随机森林、逻辑回归)评估预测稳健性；3) 机器学习可解释性方法(特征重要性和SHAP)验证结果并发现非线性模式。
AI.findings: 1) 产品类别复杂性(PCC)和技术准备度(TR)显著增加AI和AR功能采用；2) AI对决策信心(DC)有最强正向影响，AR影响相对较小；3) PCC通过数字功能使用间接影响DC，TR既有直接影响也有中介效应；4) 机器学习方法证实了AI功能和TR的主导作用，并发现了SEM未捕捉的非线性和交互模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 扩展TAM和TTF理论，将决策信心定位为采纳后的保证结果；2) 整合因果解释与预测验证方法；3) 揭示数字功能在跨境电子商务信任建立中的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 强调可解释AI的价值；2) 建议构建技术准备度的用户体验；3) 推荐开发功能丰富的产品页面以增强消费者信心；4) 为Daraz等平台提供基于Alibaba数字功能战略的实践指导，减少跨境电子商务退货行为。

title: Leading in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
affiliations: University of South Wales

detail.title: Leading in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
detail.abstract: This article examines the crucial role of leadership in harnessing Artificial Intelligence (AI) within military contexts, emphasising the importance of cultivating a culture of innovation, trust, and strategic vision. It underscores that successful AI integration requires leaders to embrace uncertainty, develop adaptive strategies, and prioritise transformative capabilities over incremental improvements. Key principles include partnering with AI to amplify human intelligence, learning through practical experimentation, and reimagining warfare to unlock new operational and strategic possibilities. The article highlights that leadership involves not only understanding technological advancements but also enabling teams, aligning organisational processes, and cultivating ethical considerations to harness AI's full potential. Ultimately, it advocates for a balanced approach where human-centric leadership and technological literacy work in tandem to create a future-ready, AI-enabled Army.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了领导力在军事领域应用人工智能中的关键作用，强调需要培养创新、信任和战略愿景的文化，主张通过人机协作、实践实验和重新构想战争来释放AI潜力。
AI.research_question: 领导力如何在军事环境中有效整合人工智能，并最大化其战略和作战价值？
AI.motivation: 随着人工智能在军事领域的快速发展，传统领导模式面临挑战，需要探索如何通过领导力变革来有效整合AI技术，实现军事转型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 变革型领导理论、创新文化理论、人机协作理论、适应性战略理论、军事伦理框架
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，基于文献综述和理论推导，提出领导力在AI整合中的关键原则和实践路径。
AI.findings: 成功的AI整合需要领导力在多个维度发挥作用：培养创新文化、建立信任、拥抱不确定性、发展适应性战略、优先考虑变革性能力而非渐进改进、通过实践实验学习、重新构想战争概念。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了军事AI领导力框架，整合了技术整合、组织变革和伦理考量；发展了人机协作领导理论；扩展了变革型领导在技术驱动环境中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为军事领导者提供了具体的AI整合指导原则；提出了培养AI素养和伦理意识的实践建议；为构建未来就绪的AI赋能军队提供了路线图。

title: Two Masks, One Face: State Capitalism and Private Feudalism as Mirrors of the Same System
affiliations: Semmelweis University

detail.title: Two Masks, One Face: State Capitalism and Private Feudalism as Mirrors of the Same System
detail.abstract: Every ideology hides behind a mask. The Soviet Union hid behind the mask of equality; America hid behind the mask of freedom. Yet underneath both, the same face looked back—the face of hierarchy. This paper argues that, despite their different histories, capitalism and communism evolved into structurally identical systems of control. In capitalist countries, private ownership concentrates power in the hands of financiers, boards, and oligarchs. In communist states, the same concentration happens under government bureaucracies and party elites. Both systems sustain inequality, suppress worker independence, and prioritize obedience over innovation. Through case studies of the Soviet Union, China, North Korea, and post-Soviet Russia, this paper shows that “state capitalism” simply swapped corporate shareholders for political Commissars. Meanwhile, “private feudalism” disguises hereditary wealth as meritocracy—both wearing masks: one face. Both uphold an illusion of fairness while maintaining control. The study concludes by examining how modern American workers—often self-described capitalists—unwittingly support Marxist ideas of workplace democracy, showing that the human longing for fairness surpasses any specific ideology.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为资本主义和共产主义在结构上已演变为相同的控制体系，都通过不同形式（私有制或官僚制）集中权力、维持不平等、压制工人自主性，并揭示了两种意识形态背后的共同等级制本质。
AI.research_question: 资本主义和共产主义是否在结构上已演变为相同的控制体系？
AI.motivation: 揭示不同意识形态（资本主义和共产主义）表面差异下隐藏的结构相似性，即都通过权力集中维持等级制和不平等。
AI.theoretical_framework: 马克思主义批判理论、权力集中理论、意识形态批判理论、比较政治经济学。
AI.method: 案例研究法，分析苏联、中国、朝鲜和后苏联俄罗斯等案例，比较资本主义和共产主义国家的权力结构。
AI.findings: 1. 资本主义和共产主义都通过不同形式集中权力（私有制vs官僚制）；2. 两者都维持不平等、压制工人自主性；3. "国家资本主义"只是将公司股东换成政治委员；4. "私人封建主义"将世袭财富伪装成精英统治；5. 美国工人实际上支持马克思主义的工作场所民主理念。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出资本主义和共产主义结构趋同理论；2. 揭示意识形态"面具"背后的共同等级制本质；3. 发展了权力集中理论的跨制度比较框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 帮助人们看透意识形态宣传的实质；2. 为工人运动提供跨制度分析工具；3. 促进对工作场所民主的追求超越意识形态标签。

title: Why Pakistan Urgently Needs Digital Will Legislation in the AI Era: Insights from the United Kingdom
affiliations: Faisalabad College of Law and Faisalabad College of Law

detail.title: Why Pakistan Urgently Needs Digital Will Legislation in the AI Era: Insights from the United Kingdom
detail.abstract: The rapid rise of internet usage, combined with advances in artificial intelligence, creates new challenges in managing personal data after death. Although this information is sensitive, Pakistan lacks clear regulations to guide heirs, regulate tech companies, or prevent commercial misuse of deceased individuals' digital footprints through automated systems. This study examines the problem via structured literature analysis, contrasting legal frameworks in Pakistan and the UK using credible academic and official sources. Major gaps emerge when digital assets are absent from inheritance laws, families hold no formal authority, while AI firms face no barriers to exploiting user data posthumously. Findings indicate immediate steps are needed: legislation supporting digital testaments, enforceable post-mortem data rights, restrictions on unauthorised algorithmic processing, alongside prohibitions on synthetic content creation without permission. The study backs giving digital assets official recognition, appointing online agents, while including safeguards against posthumous abuse. These updates aim to preserve dignity in virtual environments, at the same time aligning Pakistan with modern global standards.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨巴基斯坦在人工智能时代缺乏数字遗产管理法规的问题，通过对比英国法律框架，提出立法建议以保护逝者数字权利、限制AI公司滥用数据。
AI.research_question: 巴基斯坦如何应对人工智能时代逝者数字足迹管理的法律空白，保护个人数据免受商业滥用？
AI.motivation: 互联网普及和人工智能发展带来逝者数字数据管理新挑战，巴基斯坦缺乏明确法规指导继承人、规范科技公司或防止商业滥用逝者数字足迹。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字遗产管理理论、数据保护法律框架、比较法学（巴基斯坦与英国法律对比）、人工智能伦理与监管理论。
AI.method: 结构化文献分析，对比巴基斯坦和英国的法律框架，使用可信的学术和官方资料。
AI.findings: 主要差距：数字资产未被纳入继承法，家庭无正式授权，AI公司可无限制利用逝者数据。需要立即立法支持数字遗嘱、可执行的逝后数据权利、限制未经授权的算法处理、禁止未经许可的合成内容创建。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字遗产管理理论提供巴基斯坦语境下的实证分析，扩展人工智能伦理框架到逝后数据保护领域，丰富比较法学在数字权利保护方面的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出具体立法建议：给予数字资产官方认可、任命在线代理人、建立防止逝后滥用的保障措施，帮助巴基斯坦与国际标准接轨，保护虚拟环境中的尊严。

title: Relative Cognition and the Decay of Novelty - A Mathematical Framework for Human and Machine Intelligence
affiliations: The Notenic Learning Institute for Applied Intelligence Inc.

detail.title: Relative Cognition and the Decay of Novelty - A Mathematical Framework for Human and Machine Intelligence
detail.abstract:
As artificial intelligence (AI) systems become increasingly embedded in decision-making processes across society, the demand for clarity around their cognitive mechanisms grows proportionally. While modern AI - particularly large language models (LLMs) - can convincingly simulate human-like reasoning, communication, and task execution, they remain fundamentally different in how they process, prioritize, and act upon information. This white paper presents a comparative cognitive analysis of human and AI systems, exploring both their structural parallels and critical divergences.

We examine key cognitive dimensions: memory, reflection, moral reasoning, and role fidelity. We identify where current AI deployments fall short - not due to flaws in computational capacity, but due to the lack of structural reinforcement and ethical conditioning that underpin trust in human cognition. We argue that AI is not inherently misaligned; rather, it reflects the quality of its design, conditioning, and governance.

The Notenic Framework, built upon certified cognitive role profiles, adaptive behavior scoring, and persistent role-based governance, offers a new institutional paradigm. It allows AI to evolve as a stable, accountable actor within human systems - not merely as a predictive engine, but as a trustworthy partner. This paper concludes by outlining the societal implications of intelligent system governance, proposing Notenic’s standards as a blueprint for the next phase of responsible AI evolution.

Traditional models of cognition treat intellect, intelligence, and knowledge as discrete, static faculties. In practice, these categories are fluid - expressions of the same cognitive material viewed through the lens of observer capacity. What registers as intellect to one mind may appear as intelligence - or mere knowledge - to another. This asymmetry is not subjective. It is a mathematically modelable decay process that governs how insights lose novelty across cycles of application or transmission.

This paper introduces the Cognitive Decay Model, a formal structure that defines the transformation of high-novelty insights into stable knowledge over time, modulated by observer-specific absorption coefficients. The model is inherently relativistic: cognition is not a property of the information alone, but of the dynamic interaction between information and its interpreter. Using this foundation, we explore how human learning, institutional knowledge transfer, and artificial intelligence systems process and degrade novelty at different rates.

Notenic operationalizes this framework in its cognitive governance standards, establishing role-specific performance thresholds and determining which cognitive zones - intellect, intelligence, or knowledge - a given AI model may safely occupy. This ensures that AI autonomy scales only in proportion to its certified capacity, closing the gap between theoretical safety and practical deployment.

In short: cognition must be governed not by fixed rules, but by relativistic thresholds. What an agent is allowed to do must depend on what it is structurally capable of understanding.

AI.tldr: 该白皮书提出了Notenic框架，通过认知角色认证、行为评分和持续治理，使AI成为可信赖的合作伙伴而非单纯预测工具。同时引入认知衰减模型，将认知视为信息与解释者之间的动态交互，为AI治理提供理论基础。
AI.research_question: 如何通过认知治理框架使AI系统成为可信赖的决策伙伴，而非仅仅是预测引擎？
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统在社会决策中日益普及，需要理解其认知机制。当前AI（特别是大语言模型）能模拟人类推理，但在信息处理、优先级排序和行动方式上与人类存在根本差异，缺乏结构性强化和伦理条件，影响信任建立。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 比较认知分析框架：从记忆、反思、道德推理和角色忠诚度等维度比较人类与AI认知；2. 认知衰减模型：将智力、智能和知识视为同一认知材料的不同表现，描述高新颖性见解随时间转化为稳定知识的过程；3. 相对主义认知观：认知是信息与其解释者之间动态交互的属性。
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建：通过比较认知分析识别AI与人类的关键差异；提出Notenic框架（基于认证认知角色档案、自适应行为评分和持续角色治理）；建立认知衰减数学模型；探索人类学习、机构知识转移和AI系统处理新颖性的不同速率。
AI.findings: 1. AI并非天生错位，而是反映其设计、条件和治理质量；2. 当前AI部署的不足源于缺乏结构性强化和伦理条件；3. 认知衰减过程可数学建模；4. Notenic框架能建立角色特定性能阈值，确保AI自主性与其认证能力成比例扩展。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出相对主义认知观，将认知视为信息与解释者的动态交互；2. 建立认知衰减模型，形式化描述新颖性见解向稳定知识的转化；3. 发展AI认知治理理论框架，连接理论安全与实际部署。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供Notenic框架作为负责任AI发展的蓝图；2. 建立认知治理标准，设定角色特定性能阈值；3. 为AI系统设计、条件和治理提供具体指导；4. 提出使AI成为稳定、可问责的人类系统参与者的制度范式。

title: The Governance Gauntlet: Strategic Risk Management When Algorithms Become Your Customers

detail.title: The Governance Gauntlet: Strategic Risk Management When Algorithms Become Your Customers
detail.abstract:
When Amazon scrapped its AI recruiting tool in 2018 after discovering it systematically discriminated against female candidates, the company confronted an uncomfortable reality: algorithmic systems don’t just automate decisions—they amplify the biases embedded in their training data. When Meta faced €1.2 billion in GDPR fines for privacy violations in 2023, regulators sent an unmistakable message about the consequences of governance failures in digital markets. When Uber drivers discovered the platform’s algorithms were paying them different wages for identical work, the fiction of neutral technology collapsed. These aren’t isolated incidents—they represent the leading edge of a fundamental transformation in how commerce operates. 

The emergence of agentic commerce—where AI systems possess delegated authority to make purchasing decisions with limited human oversight—fundamentally transforms corporate governance from a compliance function into a competitive capability. Traditional governance frameworks, designed for human-centric markets where reputation management mitigates risk, prove inadequate when opaque algorithms replace human buyers. This paper develops the Governance Gauntlet framework, which reconceptualizes three critical governance domains— algorithmic bias, data privacy, and institutional trust—as interconnected strategic imperatives rather than isolated compliance burdens. Drawing on empirical evidence from Amazon’s algorithmic bias failures, Meta’s privacy governance collapses, Uber’s platform manipulation, and widespread ISO 27001 certification adoption, I demonstrate how governance excellence creates measurable competitive advantages in algorithm-intermediated markets. 

I introduce a novel risk typology distinguishing Exclusion Risk (systematic algorithmic rejection) from Inclusion Risk (association with unethical practices through AI recommendation), demonstrating how each requires distinct mitigation strategies. The framework integrates insights from algorithmic fairness literature, platform governance theory, and enterprise risk management to provide actionable guidance for organizations navigating algorithm-intermediated markets. As AI agents are projected to influence trillions in commerce within the next decade, this governance transformation represents one of the most consequential business adaptations of the digital age. Organizations that recognize governance as strategic advantage—building verifiable, machine-readable integrity signals—will thrive; those treating it as compliance overhead will face systematic exclusion from AI-mediated markets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"治理挑战框架"，将算法偏见、数据隐私和制度信任重新概念化为互联的战略要务而非孤立的合规负担，论证在AI代理商业时代，治理卓越能创造可衡量的竞争优势。
AI.research_question: 在AI代理商业（agentic commerce）时代，企业如何将治理从合规功能转变为竞争优势？
AI.motivation: 传统治理框架在AI系统获得委托决策权的商业环境中已不适用，亚马逊、Meta、Uber等公司的失败案例表明算法偏见、隐私违规和平台操纵已成为系统性风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理挑战框架整合了算法公平性文献、平台治理理论和企业风险管理，区分排斥风险（系统性算法拒绝）与包容风险（通过AI推荐与不道德实践关联）。
AI.method: 基于亚马逊算法偏见失败、Meta隐私治理崩溃、Uber平台操纵以及ISO 27001认证广泛采用等实证证据进行分析。
AI.findings: 治理卓越在算法中介市场中创造可衡量的竞争优势；组织需要建立可验证、机器可读的完整性信号；将治理视为合规负担的组织将面临系统性排斥。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出治理挑战框架，重新概念化三大治理领域；2) 引入排斥风险与包容风险的新型风险类型学；3) 将治理从合规功能重构为战略能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织在算法中介市场中提供可操作的治理指导；帮助企业建立竞争优势；提供具体的风险缓解策略；强调可验证完整性信号的重要性。

title: Performance Trade-offs of Execute-Order-Validate and Order-Execute Blockchain Architectures for IoT Workloads
affiliations: University of Wyoming and University of Wyoming

detail.title: Performance Trade-offs of Execute-Order-Validate and Order-Execute Blockchain Architectures for IoT Workloads
detail.abstract: Blockchain integration with Internet of Things (IoT) sensor networks requires platforms that provide data integrity, low latency, and reliable operation under constrained edge conditions. Yet existing evaluations focus largely on datacenter deployments, offering limited guidance for selecting permissioned platforms for industrial IoT workloads. This work presents a comprehensive empirical comparison of Hyperledger Fabric and Hyperledger Besu across seven scenarios: baseline performance, network scaling, degraded network quality, concurrent sensor workloads, systematic fault injection, long-duration energy profiling, and physical sensor-to-actuator response. Both platforms were deployed on identical Ubuntu machines while IoT workloads were generated from edge devices. Results reveal clear architectural trade-offs. Fabric’s execute–order–validate model achieves sub-second confirmation latency, faster fault recovery, and 66% fewer lost transactions under Byzantine-style adversarial client behavior, making it suitable for time-critical control applications. Besu’s order–execute architecture provides 28% lower energy consumption and 41% higher power efficiency, better suited for continuous environmental monitoring in power-limited deployments. Both platforms scaled to 740 concurrent sensors but saturated through different mechanisms—Fabric through endorsement coordination and Besu through sequential execution queues.The findings offer practical, evidence-driven guidance for selecting blockchain platforms aligned with specific IoT deployment requirements.

AI.tldr: 本文对Hyperledger Fabric和Hyperledger Besu在工业物联网场景下进行了全面的实证比较，揭示了两种区块链平台在性能、能耗和容错性方面的架构权衡，为物联网部署选择提供了实证指导。
AI.research_question: 在工业物联网边缘计算场景下，Hyperledger Fabric和Hyperledger Besu这两种许可区块链平台在性能、能耗、容错性和可扩展性方面有何差异？
AI.motivation: 现有区块链评估主要关注数据中心部署，缺乏针对工业物联网边缘计算场景下平台选择的实证指导。物联网传感器网络需要数据完整性、低延迟和在受限边缘条件下的可靠运行，因此需要基于实际部署场景的平台比较研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于区块链架构理论，特别是许可区块链平台的执行-排序-验证（Fabric）与排序-执行（Besu）两种不同架构模型，以及它们在物联网边缘计算环境下的性能特征和权衡。
AI.method: 采用实证研究方法，在相同的Ubuntu机器上部署两个平台，通过七个场景进行比较：基准性能、网络扩展、网络质量下降、并发传感器工作负载、系统故障注入、长时间能量分析和物理传感器到执行器响应。
AI.findings: Fabric的执行-排序-验证模型实现亚秒级确认延迟，故障恢复更快，在拜占庭式对抗客户端行为下交易丢失减少66%，适合时间关键的控制应用。Besu的排序-执行架构能耗降低28%，能效提高41%，更适合电力受限部署中的连续环境监测。两个平台都能扩展到740个并发传感器，但通过不同机制达到饱和。
AI.theory_contributions: 从理论上阐明了不同区块链架构模型（执行-排序-验证 vs 排序-执行）在物联网边缘计算环境下的性能权衡机制，为区块链架构设计理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工业物联网部署提供了基于证据的平台选择指南：时间关键控制应用选择Fabric，电力受限环境监测选择Besu。同时提供了具体的性能指标和扩展能力数据，帮助工程师根据具体需求做出决策。

title: Demographic, Behavioral, and Psychological Predictors of Risky Cybersecurity Behaviors Among University Students: A Multinational Cross-Sectional Study from the MENA region
affiliations: Ajman University

detail.title: Demographic, Behavioral, and Psychological Predictors of Risky Cybersecurity Behaviors Among University Students: A Multinational Cross-Sectional Study from the MENA region
detail.abstract: Background: University students in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) frequently engage in risky cybersecurity behaviors despite digital literacy initiatives. This study investigates the demographic, psychological, and behavioral drivers of these practices.Methods: We surveyed 3,009 undergraduate students across eight MENA nations from April to July 2024, assessing risky cybersecurity behaviors, privacy attitudes, and prior victimization. Data were analyzed using t-tests, ANOVA, and multiple regression.Results: Males exhibited significantly riskier behaviors than females (p < .001). Lebanese students reported the highest risk levels, while Libyan and Syrian students reported the lowest (p < .001). Unexpectedly, Dentistry and Pharmacy students engaged in more risk-taking than other disciplines. The strongest predictors were comfort with online tracking (β = 0.28) and prior cyberattack victimization (β = 0.15), suggesting that experiencing cyberattacks does not necessarily promote caution.Conclusion: Effective cybersecurity education in MENA universities must move beyond awareness campaigns to address psychological factors like surveillance desensitization and gender-specific risk perceptions. The paradoxical victimization effect and vulnerability of students in high-pressure programs like Dentistry and Pharmacy warrant targeted interventions.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了中东和北非地区大学生网络安全风险行为的驱动因素，发现男性、黎巴嫩学生以及牙科和药学专业学生风险行为更高，主要预测因素是网络追踪舒适度和先前受害经历。
AI.research_question: 中东和北非地区大学生网络安全风险行为的人口统计学、心理学和行为学驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管有数字素养倡议，中东和北非地区大学生仍频繁从事网络安全风险行为，需要了解这些行为的驱动因素以制定更有效的干预措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合人口统计学理论（性别、国籍）、心理学理论（隐私态度、风险感知）和行为学理论（先前受害经历对后续行为的影响）。
AI.method: 对8个中东和北非国家的3009名本科生进行问卷调查（2024年4-7月），评估风险网络安全行为、隐私态度和先前受害经历，使用t检验、方差分析和多元回归分析数据。
AI.findings: 1. 男性比女性风险行为显著更高；2. 黎巴嫩学生风险最高，利比亚和叙利亚学生最低；3. 牙科和药学学生比其他专业风险更高；4. 主要预测因素是在线追踪舒适度和先前网络攻击受害经历。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了"受害者悖论效应"——经历网络攻击不一定促进谨慎行为；2. 揭示了特定专业（高压力项目）的网络安全脆弱性；3. 强调了心理因素（监控脱敏）在网络安全行为中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议超越意识宣传，针对心理因素设计网络安全教育；2. 需要性别特定的干预措施；3. 对牙科、药学等高压力专业学生需要针对性干预；4. 应关注监控脱敏和受害者悖论效应。

reference: FRB of Philadelphia Working Paper No. 25-39
title: Hospital Billing Regulations and Financial Well-Being: Evidence from California’s Fair Pricing Law
affiliations: Johns Hopkins University - Carey Business School, University of California, Irvine and Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia

detail.title: Hospital Billing Regulations and Financial Well-Being: Evidence from California’s Fair Pricing Law

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of Philadelphia Working Paper No. 25-39
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We examine the financial consequences of the 2007 California Fair Pricing Law, which places a price ceiling on hospital bills for financially vulnerable individuals. Exploiting cross-sectional variation in exposure to the law, we estimate its impact on individual financial distress. We find that the law reduces the likelihood of incurring non-medical debt in collections by 19.8 percent and the number of non-medical collections by 39 percent for an individual living in a county with average exposure in California. In addition, we find suggestive evidence that the number of delinquent accounts decreased for exposed individuals. Our results suggest hospital billing regulations can improve targeted individuals’ financial outcomes.

AI.tldr: 加州公平定价法对医院账单设置价格上限，显著降低了弱势群体的非医疗债务催收概率和数量，改善了他们的财务状况。
AI.research_question: 加州2007年公平定价法对弱势群体财务困境的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究医院账单法规是否能够有效保护弱势群体免受医疗债务导致的财务困境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价格上限理论、医疗债务与财务困境关系、法规对消费者保护的影响。
AI.method: 利用加州各县对法律的暴露程度差异进行横截面分析，估计对个人财务困境的影响。
AI.findings: 法律使加州平均暴露县居民的非医疗债务催收概率降低19.8%，催收数量减少39%，并有证据显示拖欠账户减少。
AI.theory_contributions: 为价格上限法规在医疗领域的有效性提供实证证据，拓展了医疗债务与财务困境关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明医院账单法规能够有效改善弱势群体的财务状况，为政策制定者提供监管依据。
